targeting_lens.brief: Round lens with a crosshair, a tiny planet caught in its centre. Accent: teal.
targeting_lens.description: Seen straight on: a round lens in a thick riveted ring, a crosshair across the glass with a tiny teal planet caught in its centre, one adjustment knob.

power_cell.brief: Battery with a round window showing a tiny caught star. Accent: mustard.
power_cell.description: An upright battery cylinder with two chunky terminals on top; a round window in its middle shows a tiny caught star as a flat mustard shape.

coolant_tank.brief: Dented tank with a chunk of comet ice behind a porthole. Accent: teal.
coolant_tank.description: Upright: a dented steel tank with a round porthole showing a chunk of comet ice inside, a teal frost-rimmed valve on top and a short hose coiled at its foot.

lucky_comet.brief: Pebble-sized comet on a knotted string. Accent: cream.
lucky_comet.description: A tiny comet the size of a pebble on a knotted string, its tail three short flat cream strokes, worn smooth on one side from being rubbed for luck.

solar_panel.brief: Two hinged satellite solar wings on a swivel joint. Accent: teal.
solar_panel.description: Lying across the box: two hinged solar wings like a satellite's, a grid of flat teal cells, a small swivel joint in the middle, one corner cracked.

repair_kit.brief: Magnet-footed tin box with a wrench and a tethered tape roll. Accent: coral red.
repair_kit.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long flat tin toolbox with rounded corners on small magnet feet, a long wrench strapped along the whole lid, a roll of hull tape on a tether at one end, a coral red stripe round it.

antenna.brief: Bent whip antenna with a tiny dish catching signal arcs. Accent: mustard.
antenna.description: A short base with a bent whip antenna, its tip a tiny dish catching three flat mustard signal arcs.

thruster.brief: Long rocket thruster with fins and a strap to wear it. Accent: coral red.
thruster.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long rocket thruster on its side, the wide scorched coral red nozzle at one end, the fuel cylinder at the other, two side fins and a buckled strap to wear it like a jetpack.

fuel_canister.brief: Rocket-fuel jerrycan with a gauge, a fuel drop floating out. Accent: coral red.
fuel_canister.description: A small jerrycan for rocket fuel with a coral red flame stencil, a pressure gauge on its cap, one round drop of fuel floating out of the spout.

crystal_shard.brief: Jagged crystal spike from Facet with splinters orbiting it. Accent: teal.
crystal_shard.description: A jagged teal crystal spike from the crystal planet Facet, hard flat facets, two tiny crystal splinters orbiting it.

copper_wire.brief: Coil of copper wire on a spool, a loose loop floating away. Accent: copper.
copper_wire.description: A neat coil of copper wire wound on a little spool, one end ending in a tiny clip, one loose loop floating away as if in zero gravity.

scrap_metal.brief: Bent hull plate with rivets and half a painted star. Accent: copper.
scrap_metal.description: A bent square of hull plate with three rivets, one torn edge and half of a painted star, copper patina in the corners.

venom_sac.brief: Venom sac of a Murk swamp creature, sealed with a valve clip. Accent: sage.
venom_sac.description: A swollen sage venom sac from a swamp creature of Murk, dark veins, its neck sealed with a little valve clip, one drop hanging from the tip.

frost_gem.brief: Six-sided gem of Rime methane ice with a frost crown. Accent: teal.
frost_gem.description: A six-sided teal gem cut from the methane ice of a frozen night planet, frozen bubbles inside, frost spikes growing from its top like a crown.

lodestone.brief: Magnetic rock with nails stuck to it and a screw in orbit. Accent: coral red.
lodestone.description: A lumpy dark rock with a few tiny nails and a bolt stuck to its sides, coral red rust round them, and one small screw orbiting it.

oxygen_tank.brief: Oxygen bottle with gauge and mask, air bubbles floating out. Accent: teal.
oxygen_tank.description: Upright: a tall teal oxygen bottle with a round gauge at the neck, a breathing mask hanging on its strap, three air bubbles floating from the valve as round outlines.

biogel.brief: Squishy gel pouch with one living cell swimming inside. Accent: sage.
biogel.description: A soft squishy pouch with a nozzle on top, sage gel inside with one round living cell swimming in it, two tiny tails.

overclock_chip.brief: Square microchip with an arrow, two legs bent as if running. Accent: mustard.
overclock_chip.description: A square microchip seen from above, short legs on all sides, a mustard arrow on top pointing forward, two of its legs bent as if it is running.

star_chart.brief: Rolled-out galaxy chart with dotted routes and a pin. Accent: mustard.
star_chart.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long chart of a spiral galaxy unrolled flat, both ends still curled into rolls, dotted travel lines between three small planets, a pin stuck in one mustard star, no writing.

gravity_anchor.brief: Small ship anchor ringed by two orbit lines. Accent: copper.
gravity_anchor.description: A small heavy ship anchor, its shaft ringed by two thin orbit lines like a tiny planet's.

geiger_counter.brief: Handheld counter pointing its wand at a radioactive pebble. Accent: mustard.
geiger_counter.description: A chunky handheld counter with a mustard needle dial, its wand on a coiled cable pointing at a small asteroid pebble marked with three radiation wedges.

jammer_beacon.brief: Tall beacon mast on landing legs sending a zig-zag signal. Accent: coral red.
jammer_beacon.description: Standing tall from the bottom to the top of the box: a tall thin beacon mast on three landing legs at the bottom, a small dish halfway up, a coral red zig-zag signal wave coming off the very top.

med_scanner.brief: Handheld scanner showing a heartbeat line, scan fan from its tip. Accent: sage.
med_scanner.description: A handheld scanner with a small screen showing a sage heartbeat line, a fan of flat teal scan lines spreading from its tip.

stardust_vial.brief: Corked vial with stardust spiralling like a tiny galaxy. Accent: mustard.
stardust_vial.description: A corked glass vial with mustard stardust inside, drawn as flat specks spiralling like a tiny galaxy, a short tether string on the cork.

holo_decoy.brief: Projector puck casting a dashed teal astronaut. Accent: teal.
holo_decoy.description: A small projector puck casting the silhouette of an astronaut made of teal dashes above it.

war_horn.brief: Ridged horn shed by a Rime yak, ice still on its tip. Accent: copper.
war_horn.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long curved ridged horn shed by a Rime yak, lying flat, ice crust on its wide end, a copper mouthpiece at the narrow end, a cord tied round its middle.

star_compass.brief: Brass compass whose needle is a little comet. Accent: copper.
star_compass.description: An old brass compass seen from above, its needle a little comet with a short tail, pointing at one star on the dial instead of a letter.

warp_coil.brief: Tall twisted teal coil bending space, a bolt stretched by it. Accent: teal.
warp_coil.description: Standing tall from the bottom to the top of the box: a tall spring-like coil of thick teal wire, the space beside it drawn as curved bending lines, a small bolt next to it stretched long as if pulled in.

black_box.brief: Armoured flight recorder with warning stripes and a handle. Accent: coral red.
black_box.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long low armoured flight recorder, a carry handle along the top, coral red warning stripes on both ends, dented corners.

dark_matter.brief: Floating black sphere bending the stars around it. Accent: cream.
dark_matter.description: A floating black sphere with a thin cream rim, the few stars next to it bent into short arcs, nothing else. Simple and very dark.

metronome.brief: Metronome made from a rocket nose cone, star on its arm. Accent: mustard.
metronome.description: Standing tall from the bottom to the top of the box: a tall slim metronome made from a rocket nose cone, its long arm reaching up past the tip with a small mustard star at the end.

singularity_core.brief: Cracked containment sphere around a tiny black hole. Accent: coral red.
singularity_core.description: Filling the square box: a round containment sphere in a riveted iron frame, its shell cracked; the cracks bend inward towards a tiny black hole in the middle, a coral red ring around it. Fragments drift towards the centre.

nebula_prism.brief: Glass prism splitting one beam into three colour bands. Accent: mustard.
nebula_prism.description: Filling the square box: a heavy triangular glass prism on a small iron stand, a single beam entering one side and leaving as three flat bands of mustard, teal and coral red.

first_aid_patch.brief: Domed suit-repair patch with a cross, one corner peeling. Accent: coral red.
first_aid_patch.description: A square suit-repair patch with a coral red cross, slightly domed as if sealing a leak, one corner peeling up.

saline_drip.brief: IV bag floating on a tether, liquid forming a ball. Accent: teal.
saline_drip.description: Upright: a soft IV bag floating on a short tether instead of hanging, the drip line looping in a curl, the teal liquid inside forming a round ball.

scrubber_unit.brief: Boxy air scrubber with a dusty filter mat and helmet hose. Accent: sage.
scrubber_unit.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long low air scrubber with a fan grille at each end, a sage filter mat full of trapped dust along the top, a ribbed hose looping from one end.

regen_pod.brief: Capsule pod with a sleeping blob behind a porthole. Accent: sage.
regen_pod.description: Filling the square box: a squat capsule pod with a round porthole window; inside a sleeping sage blob. Pipes on the side, a few dents.

healing_spring.brief: Moon-rock basin, water rising as floating balls in low gravity. Accent: teal.
healing_spring.description: Filling the square box: a small basin of pale moon rock, water rising from its middle as floating teal balls in low gravity, sage moss on the rim.

stasis_field.brief: Two emitter prongs holding a frozen bubble with an item inside. Accent: teal.
stasis_field.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: two tall emitter prongs at the far left and far right ends of a long bar, a stretched frozen bubble between them with a small item stuck inside.

emergency_beacon.brief: Distress beacon on landing legs with a caged warning lamp. Accent: coral red.
emergency_beacon.description: Filling the square box: a heavy distress beacon on four landing legs, a big coral red warning lamp in a cage on top, a folded antenna dish on one side and a pull handle on a chain.

hull_plating.brief: Curved hull slab with a porthole and a welded patch. Accent: copper.
hull_plating.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long curved slab of ship hull, rivets along its edges, two small round portholes with a star behind the glass, a copper patch welded over a dent.

space_suit.brief: Empty space suit hanging limp, helmet on a strap, tether drifting. Accent: teal.
space_suit.description: Standing tall from the bottom to the top of the box: an empty space suit hanging upright and limp, round helmet at the top, boots at the bottom, a teal patch on one knee, a short tether drifting from its belt.

visor_helmet.brief: Round helmet, almost all visor, a ringed planet reflected in it. Accent: mustard.
visor_helmet.description: A round helmet seen from the front, almost all visor: a big mustard-tinted window reflecting a small ringed planet as a flat shape, a short antenna on top.

lead_vest.brief: Heavy vest of lead bands like an armadillo, trefoil patch. Accent: mustard.
lead_vest.description: Standing tall from the bottom to the top of the box: a long heavy vest of overlapping grey lead bands like an armadillo's shell reaching down to the knees, thick shoulder straps, a mustard radiation trefoil patch on the chest.

ablative_tiles.brief: Stack of three hexagonal re-entry tiles, scorched edges. Accent: coral red.
ablative_tiles.description: A short stack of three hexagonal heat tiles from a re-entry shield, seen slightly from above, edges scorched coral red and black, the top tile split by one crack.

magnetic_boots.brief: Pair of space boots with horseshoe magnets on the soles. Accent: coral red.
magnetic_boots.description: A pair of chunky space boots side by side, soles towards the viewer, each sole a big coral red horseshoe magnet with a lost bolt stuck to it.

rock_shell.brief: Domed shell of layered red sandstone from Ochre. Accent: copper.
rock_shell.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long low domed shell from the heavy-gravity desert of Ochre, built of flat stacked layers of red sandstone like a long squat mesa, two short straps underneath to wear it.

pilot_jacket.brief: Flight jacket with tiny thruster nozzles at the cuffs. Accent: copper.
pilot_jacket.description: Standing tall from the bottom to the top of the box: a long leather flight coat hanging upright, puffy collar turned up, reaching down past the hips, tiny thruster nozzles round each cuff, a patch showing a small rocket.

reactive_armor.brief: Chest plate covered in round charges, two blown open. Accent: coral red.
reactive_armor.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long belt-shaped armour plate covered in a row of small round charges like bubble wrap, coral red caps, two of them already blown open and blackened.

deflector_dish.brief: Satellite dish used as a shield, a ring of force in front of the bowl. Accent: teal.
deflector_dish.description: Filling the square box: an old satellite dish seen from the front, bowl facing the viewer, the small receiver arm in its centre, used as a shield; a flat teal ring of force hovers just in front of the bowl. Bent rim, one missing panel.

cryo_coat.brief: Long coat of ice-spiked Rime fur with snowshoe flaps. Accent: teal.
cryo_coat.description: Standing tall from the bottom to the top of the box: a long coat of shaggy Rime yak fur hanging upright, stiff teal ice spikes along the shoulders, wide snowshoe flaps at the hem, icicles hanging from the cuffs.

thorn_mail.brief: Vest woven from Murk's black thorn vines. Accent: sage.
thorn_mail.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long belt of armour woven from the thick black thorn vines of the fog planet Murk, hooked thorns at every crossing, a few sage leaves curled into spirals.

mirror_shield.brief: Round shield from a telescope mirror, a ringed planet reflected. Accent: cream.
mirror_shield.description: Filling the square box: a round shield made from a telescope mirror, heavy riveted rim, its flat face showing a reflected ringed planet as a simple cream shape. No shine.

force_bubble.brief: Wrist emitter projecting a cracked half-dome of force. Accent: teal.
force_bubble.description: Lying across the box: a chunky wrist emitter on the left, from it a half-dome of force drawn as a flat teal arc with one crack running through it.

nano_weave.brief: Cloth of tiny hexagons, some walking away on little legs. Accent: teal.
nano_weave.description: Standing tall from the bottom to the top of the box: a long hanging banner of cloth made of tiny teal hexagons, a few hexagons peeling off the bottom edge and walking away on tiny legs.

phase_cloak.brief: Hooded cloak cut from a nebula, fading into dashes below. Accent: cream.
phase_cloak.description: Standing tall from the bottom to the top of the box: a long hooded cloak hanging upright, cut from the Veil nebula, the top half solid dark cloth with a few cream stars, the lower half breaking up into rows of dashes.

bulwark_generator.brief: Big generator on landing legs with shield fins and a force dome. Accent: mustard.
bulwark_generator.description: Filling the wide box: a big boxy generator on four short landing legs, two angled shield fins on top like ears, a flat teal half-dome of force arching over it with one crack, mustard and black hazard stripes along the base, heavy cables on the sides.

shield_battery.brief: Fat battery cell topped by a little shield dome. Accent: teal.
shield_battery.description: Upright: a fat battery cell whose top is a small round shield dome, a stepped charge meter of three bars on its side, two filled in teal.

thermal_blanket.brief: Foil rescue blanket bundle, one corner floating up. Accent: mustard.
thermal_blanket.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a crinkled foil rescue blanket rolled into a long tube, creases as hard flat mustard and cream facets, one loose corner floating up, a tether clip at one end.

dyson_fragment.brief: Curved slab cut from a sphere around a star. Accent: mustard.
dyson_fragment.description: Filling the square box: a curved slab cut from a giant sphere around a star, the inside facing the viewer with a grid of mustard panels and struts, the broken edges jagged.

wormhole_generator.brief: Ring machine with a swirling hole full of distant stars. Accent: teal.
wormhole_generator.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long machine with a fat ring at each end and a stretched oval tunnel between them, the tunnel showing a few distant stars in teal.

time_dilator.brief: Caged hourglass with the sand frozen mid-fall. Accent: teal.
time_dilator.description: Upright: an hourglass in a metal cage, the sand frozen in mid-fall in the narrow neck, frost on the glass.

ancient_monolith.brief: Small black standing stone carved with a galaxy, pebbles floating round it. Accent: cream.
ancient_monolith.description: A small black standing stone worn smooth, an old carving of a spiral galaxy filled with flat cream, a few pebbles floating around it.

quantum_dice.brief: Two dice drawn with overlapping outlines. Accent: teal.
quantum_dice.description: Two dice side by side, each drawn with several overlapping outlines as if showing more than one face at once.

plague_vault.brief: Sealed hazard jar leaking fumes round its seal. Accent: sage.
plague_vault.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long sealed hazard canister lying on its side with a clamped lid at each end, sage fumes leaking round both seals in curls.

titan_core.brief: Heavy reactor core in a spiked armoured cage. Accent: coral red.
titan_core.description: Filling the square box: a heavy reactor core inside an armoured cage, spikes on the cage corners, a coral red window on the core.

star_forge.brief: Anvil with a tiny star burning in a dish beside it. Accent: mustard.
star_forge.description: Lying across the box: a small anvil with a tiny star burning in a dish beside it instead of a fire, sparks drawn as flat mustard flecks.

galactic_cookbook.brief: Thick stained cookbook with a planet on the cover. Accent: copper.
galactic_cookbook.description: A thick stained book with a planet on the cover and bookmarks sticking out, no letters.

zoo_beacon.brief: Signal lamp with alien paw prints on its lens. Accent: mustard.
zoo_beacon.description: A small signal lamp on a base, its lens marked with mustard paw prints of different alien feet, one three-toed, one six-toed.

field_pack.brief: Starting backpack from above: a canvas rim with straps, the middle plain. Accent: copper.
field_pack.description: Seen flat from above: a thin worn canvas rim, two strap buckles on the top edge, a narrow rolled mat along it, a copper clip in one corner. The inside is one plain dark field.

pouch.brief: Square space-suit glove pouch: a drawstring rim, the middle plain. Accent: copper.
pouch.description: Seen flat from above: a square soft pouch filling the box, a drawstring rim of space-suit glove fabric, a folded thumb tab on the edge. Inside one plain dark field.

belt_pocket.brief: Canvas pocket: belt loop and snap on the rim, the middle plain. Accent: copper.
belt_pocket.description: Seen flat from above: a thin canvas rim, a belt loop along the top edge and one snap button on it. The inside is one plain dark field.

sling_bag.brief: Tube bag: strap along one edge, the middle plain. Accent: copper.
sling_bag.description: Seen flat from above: a thin canvas rim, the strap as a narrow band along one long edge ending in a buckle. The inside is one plain dark field.

side_pocket.brief: L-shaped pocket: zip along the inner corner, the middle plain. Accent: copper.
side_pocket.description: Seen flat from above: an L-shaped canvas rim, the zip running along the inner corner; the empty corner of the box stays free. The inside is one plain dark field.

cargo_pocket.brief: Utility pocket: folded flap and buckle on the top edge, the middle plain. Accent: copper.
cargo_pocket.description: Seen flat from above: a thin canvas rim, a folded flap as a band along the top edge with one heavy buckle. The inside is one plain dark field.

duffel.brief: Duffel: zip all round the rim, two handles, the middle plain. Accent: copper.
duffel.description: Seen flat from above: the zip running all round as a thin rim, two handles lying flat over the top edge, one patched end. The inside is one plain dark field.

cooler_bag.brief: Cooler bag: quilted rim with frost on the zip, the middle plain. Accent: teal.
cooler_bag.description: Seen flat from above: a quilted rim, frost only on the zip, a small snowflake patch in one corner. The inside is one plain dark field.

holster.brief: Leather bag: thick rim with two buckled straps, the middle plain. Accent: copper.
holster.description: Seen flat from above: a thick leather rim, two buckled straps on one side edge. The inside is one plain dark field.

tool_roll.brief: Tool roll: row of empty spanner loops on the bottom edge, the middle plain. Accent: copper.
tool_roll.description: Seen flat from above: a canvas rim, a row of empty spanner loops only along the bottom edge, a tie cord at one corner. The inside is one plain dark field.

pet_carrier.brief: Pet carrier: hard rim with a barred window, the middle plain. Accent: copper.
pet_carrier.description: Seen flat from above: a hard shell rim, a small barred window in one side wall, a paw sticker in a corner. The inside is one plain dark field.

seed_satchel.brief: Seed satchel: canvas rim with a leaf patch, the middle plain. Accent: sage.
seed_satchel.description: Seen flat from above: a thin canvas rim, a sage leaf patch on the flap at the top edge. The inside is one plain dark field.

relic_case.brief: Relic case: brass corners and a star seal, the middle plain. Accent: mustard.
relic_case.description: Seen flat from above: a thin old case rim with brass corner caps and a mustard star seal on the top edge. The inside is one plain dark field.

padded_case.brief: Padded case: puffy padded rim, the middle plain. Accent: coral red.
padded_case.description: Seen flat from above: a puffy padded rim all round, a small coral red stitched patch in one corner. The inside is one plain dark field.

stasis_vault.brief: Stasis vault: thick riveted walls and a frozen lock dial, the middle plain. Accent: teal.
stasis_vault.description: Seen flat from above: thick riveted walls as the rim, a frost-covered lock dial on the front wall. The inside is one plain dark field.

prism_laser.brief: Laser pistol with a Facet crystal prism clamped over its lens rings. Accent: teal.
prism_laser.description: Upright, barrel up: the chunky Laser Pistol with its three teal lens rings, a jagged Facet crystal clamped on top as a prism, nothing leaving the muzzle.

twin_lasers.brief: Two laser pistols welded side by side on one shared grip. Accent: coral red.
twin_lasers.description: Filling the square box: two chunky laser pistols welded side by side, barrels up, their teal lens-ring barrels parallel, both solar fins joined into one wide fin, one shared taped double grip below.

nail_storm.brief: Rivet gun fed by a copper wire spool, one rivet in flight. Accent: copper.
nail_storm.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long rivet gun with a thruster-nozzle muzzle at one end, a fat copper wire spool bolted on top feeding a belt of rivets in, the grip at the other end. No projectiles.

flamethrower.brief: Plasma cutter with a fuel can underneath, no flame. Accent: coral red.
flamethrower.description: Running the full length of the long box, end to end: a long welding-torch plasma cutter, a red rocket-fuel jerrycan with a pressure gauge strapped underneath, the coral red nozzle rim at one end and the grip at the other, no flame.

slag_mace.brief: Little asteroid fused onto a bent hull-plate pole. Accent: coral red.
slag_mace.description: Upright: the lumpy grey-brown little asteroid fused onto a pole of bent riveted hull plate, the weld seams drawn as flat coral red cracks, its pebble moon still circling close.

glacier_cannon.brief: Cryo sprayer grown into a fat ice-caked cannon with a coolant tank. Accent: teal.
glacier_cannon.description: Filling the square box: a short fat cannon caked in flat teal hexagon ice, the dented coolant tank with its comet-ice porthole strapped on its back, frost crust round the muzzle.

fungal_mortar.brief: Puffball mortar tube with Murk mushrooms sprouting from the barrel. Accent: sage.
fungal_mortar.description: Filling the square box: a stubby mortar tube grown from a giant Murk puffball fungus, three dish-capped sage mushrooms sprouting from its rim, one round spore pod sitting in the mouth.

emp_cannon.brief: Ion blaster rings around a jammer dish, one zig-zag spark. Accent: mustard.
emp_cannon.description: Filling the square box: a squat cannon whose barrel is three floating teal rings like the Ion Blaster, a jammer dish on top, a flat mustard zig-zag spark jumping between the rings.

plasma_katana.brief: Slim curved plasma blade with a Facet crystal in the guard. Accent: coral red.
plasma_katana.description: Upright through the tall box: a slim curved flat coral red plasma blade with a black core line, a docking-clamp hilt wrapped in tape, a teal Facet crystal set into the guard.

winch_harpoon.brief: Harpoon launcher with a big copper winch drum of cable. Accent: copper.
winch_harpoon.description: Running the full length of the long box, end to end: a long harpoon launcher, its barbed magnet head at one end, a big copper winch drum of cable under the middle, a crank handle, the grip at the far end.

venom_fang.brief: Crystal fang dagger with a venom sac lashed to its hilt. Accent: sage.
venom_fang.description: The curved cream Facet fang dagger with its teal crystal tip, a swollen sage venom sac lashed to the hilt, one drop hanging from the point.

cryo_baton.brief: Antenna-mast baton with a frost gem between its prongs. Accent: teal.
cryo_baton.description: Upright: the broken antenna-mast baton, a six-sided teal frost gem clamped between its two prongs, ice spikes up the shaft, coiled tether cord with a clip at the grip.

burst_rifle.brief: Needle rifle with a targeting lens scope, one needle in flight. Accent: mustard.
burst_rifle.description: Running the full length of the long box, end to end: a long thin needle rifle, its crystal needle drum under the middle, a round riveted targeting lens with crosshair as its scope, stock at one end and muzzle at the other.

laser_turret.brief: Scrap tripod turret with a crystal eye and copper wire. Accent: teal.
laser_turret.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long low turret welded from scrap hull plate, a teal Facet crystal as a long barrel reaching to one end, copper wire wrapped round its tripod legs.

buzz_blade.brief: Saw-toothed disc on a boomerang handle with thrusters. Accent: copper.
buzz_blade.description: The round saw disc with black triangle teeth fills the top left cells, the boomerang wing handle bends down the left cell with a tiny thruster at its tip; the lower right cell stays empty.

acid_sprayer.brief: Cryo sprayer whose tank is now an acid flask. Accent: sage.
acid_sprayer.description: Pistol aiming right: the gun body runs along the whole top row, a round sage acid flask set into it, the nozzle ending at the top right edge, no drip; the grip drops straight down the lower left cell; nothing in the lower right.

reinforced_bulkhead.brief: Hull plate doubled with scrap, cross braces and big bolts. Accent: copper.
reinforced_bulkhead.description: Running the full length of the long box, end to end: a long thick slab of ship hull like a bulkhead door lying on its side, scrap plates welded in X braces along it, big copper bolts, a round porthole riveted shut.

spiked_bulkhead.brief: Hull plate studded with reactive charges and spikes on the rim. Accent: coral red.
spiked_bulkhead.description: Filling the square box: a heavy hull-plate panel, its middle a grid of round coral red reactive charges, short sharp spikes along the rim, rivets at the corners.

exo_suit.brief: Exo frame torso with iron shoulder brace and spine rail. Accent: mustard.
exo_suit.description: Filling the square box: the upper body of a space suit strapped into a yellow exo frame, wide iron shoulder braces reaching both top corners, a spine rail, one piston arm brace reaching down to the bottom edge. No legs.

aegis_projector.brief: Satellite dish shield powered by a star cell, hexagon of force. Accent: teal.
aegis_projector.description: Filling the square box: the old satellite dish seen from the front, the star-window power cell strapped to its arm, a flat teal hexagon of force hovering in front of the bowl.

thorn_plate.brief: Hull-plate chest armour wrapped in Murk thorn vines. Accent: sage.
thorn_plate.description: Filling the square box: a curved hull-plate chest piece with rivets, wrapped in thick black Murk thorn vines with hooked thorns, a few sage leaves curling at the edges.

hazmat_suit.brief: Bulky space suit with lead-band collar and trefoil patch. Accent: mustard.
hazmat_suit.description: Filling the square box: a bulky puffed space suit, the overlapping grey lead bands of the vest as a collar and chest, a mustard radiation trefoil patch, a round helmet hanging at its side.

glacier_mail.brief: Yak-fur coat armoured with frost gem plates. Accent: teal.
glacier_mail.description: Filling the square box: the shaggy Rime yak-fur coat, its chest covered in six-sided teal frost gem plates like scales, ice spikes on the shoulders.

ghost_shroud.brief: Phase cloak hood with a holo projector puck, dashes below. Accent: cream.
ghost_shroud.description: Filling the square box: a wide cream cloak with an empty starry hood at the top, spread open to both sides, its lower half breaking into rows of cream dashes down to the bottom edge; a small holo puck at the collar.

sniper_scope.brief: Targeting lens extended into a long scope with a crystal lens. Accent: teal.
sniper_scope.description: A short fat scope tube seen at an angle, the riveted targeting-lens ring at its front holding a teal Facet crystal as the lens, crosshair on the glass.

fusion_battery.brief: Star-window power cell wrapped in copper wire coil. Accent: mustard.
fusion_battery.description: An upright battery cell wrapped tightly in copper wire coil, its round window showing the tiny caught star as a flat mustard shape.

afterburner.brief: Thruster nozzle with a fuel can strapped on, flat flame. Accent: coral red.
afterburner.description: Lying across the box: the stubby strap-on thruster nozzle with its coral red rim, a red fuel jerrycan strapped on its side, a short flat flame shape leaving the nozzle.

nano_medkit.brief: Repair tin with a biogel window and tiny bots on the lid. Accent: sage.
nano_medkit.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long flat repair tin on magnet feet, a long window of sage gel along its lid, two tiny six-legged repair bots crawling over it.

solar_array.brief: Three hinged solar wings on a mast with an antenna dish. Accent: teal.
solar_array.description: Running the full length of the long box, end to end: three wide flat satellite solar wings with teal cells, hinged edge to edge in one long straight line, a thin mast along their back, a small antenna dish at one end.

astrolabe.brief: Brass rings of the star chart around a stardust vial. Accent: mustard.
astrolabe.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long brass orrery with tilted elliptical rings stretched wide, the stardust vial with its tiny spiral galaxy in the middle, small planets riding the outer rings at both ends.

shock_trap.brief: Spring jaw trap with a holo decoy puck as bait. Accent: mustard.
shock_trap.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long flat spring jaw trap of salvaged metal, wide open, the holo puck in its middle casting a small teal dashed astronaut, a mustard zig-zag spark across the jaws.

fallout_beacon.brief: Lodestone base with a geiger dial and a trefoil lamp. Accent: mustard.
fallout_beacon.description: A lumpy dark lodestone with bolts stuck to it as the base, a geiger counter dial set into it, a small lamp on top with a mustard trefoil.

war_banner.brief: Tattered banner on a pole with the yak horn and a lucky comet. Accent: coral red.
war_banner.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a pole lying flat from end to end, a long tattered coral red banner streaming along it showing a comet shape, the ridged Rime yak horn tied at one end.

crit_array.brief: Brass star compass with small targeting lenses around it. Accent: teal.
crit_array.description: Seen from above: the old brass star compass with its comet needle, a ring of four small riveted targeting lenses around its rim, crosshairs on each.

overdrive_core.brief: Running microchip bolted on a thruster block. Accent: coral red.
overdrive_core.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long thruster block with exhaust vents at one end, the square microchip with its mustard arrow bolted on top, flat coral red speed stripes along the housing.

life_tank.brief: Oxygen bottle on a repair tin with a red cross and hose. Accent: coral red.
life_tank.description: Filling the square box: the tall teal oxygen bottle standing in the rounded repair tin, a coral red cross on the tin, the breathing mask hose looped round both.

inferno_canister.brief: Two fuel jerrycans welded together with one shared gauge. Accent: coral red.
inferno_canister.description: Upright: two red rocket-fuel jerrycans welded on top of each other, flame stencils on both, one shared pressure gauge, a flat coral red flame tongue at the spout.

toxic_gland.brief: Two venom sacs grown into one, sealed by valve clips. Accent: sage.
toxic_gland.description: Upright: two swollen sage venom sacs grown together into one long gland, dark veins, a valve clip at each end, one drop hanging below.

blizzard_gem.brief: Two frost gems grown together into a crowned cluster. Accent: teal.
blizzard_gem.description: Standing tall from the bottom to the top of the box: two long six-sided teal methane-ice crystals grown together upright into one tall cluster, frozen bubbles inside, frost spikes crowning the top.

prism_cluster.brief: Several Facet crystal spikes grown from one base. Accent: teal.
prism_cluster.description: A cluster of three jagged teal Facet crystal spikes growing from one rock base, hard flat facets, two tiny splinters orbiting.

reactor_heart.brief: Round reactor core in copper coils, shaped like a heart. Accent: coral red.
reactor_heart.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a heart-shaped reactor core in an iron cage in the middle, copper coils running out to big thruster vents at the far left and far right, a coral red window in its centre.

fire_drakeling.brief: Dragon hatchling with basalt skin, still half in a cosmic egg. Accent: coral red.
fire_drakeling.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a dragon hatchling in side view stretched flat, head at one end, long tail at the other, cracked black basalt skin with coral red heat in the cracks, stubby wings, eggshell on its tail. One single animal.

frost_hatchling.brief: Dragon hatchling with comet-ice scales, frosty breath. Accent: teal.
frost_hatchling.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a dragon hatchling in side view stretched flat, head at one end, long tail at the other, pale teal comet-ice scales, a frost crest, a flat puff of frost breath. One single animal.

slime_pup.brief: Puppy made of biogel with one living cell inside. Accent: sage.
slime_pup.description: Standing tall from the bottom to the top of the box: a puppy made of see-through sage biogel sitting up tall on its haunches, head held high, one floppy ear, a round living cell with two tails visible inside its belly. One single animal.

clockwork_chick.brief: Wind-up chick with copper wire feathers and a key. Accent: copper.
clockwork_chick.description: A small round wind-up chick with feathers of coiled copper wire, a winding key on its back, cream eggshell cap. One single animal.

hamster_wheel.brief: Space hamster running in a wheel with a power cell. Accent: mustard.
hamster_wheel.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long copper treadmill drum lying on its side, the round mustard space hamster running inside, cheeks full of ore, a star-window power cell wired to one end of the axle. One single animal.

lunar_moth.brief: Large pale moth with full moons and stardust on its wings. Accent: cream.
lunar_moth.description: A pale moth from a two-moon planet, wings spread, each wing marked with a full cream moon and a crescent, stardust specks drifting off the wing tips.

fortress_crab.brief: Sandstone crab carrying a hull plate as its shell. Accent: copper.
fortress_crab.description: Filling the square box: the squat Ochre rock crab with periscope eyes, carrying a riveted hull plate with a porthole as its shell, one thick crystal claw. One single animal.

plague_slug.brief: Vacuum slug with Murk mushrooms growing on its back. Accent: sage.
plague_slug.description: Filling the square box: the fat hull slug with its round suction mouth and dome shell, dish-capped sage mushrooms sprouting from its back, a slime trail. One single animal.

welder_bot.brief: Repair bot with a welding torch arm and scrap shield. Accent: mustard.
welder_bot.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a small round repair bot in the middle with one mustard eye, one long arm reaching to one end with a welding torch, the other arm holding a long scrap plate shield out to the other end.

gunship_drone.brief: Sentry drone with a laser pistol slung under its belly. Accent: coral red.
gunship_drone.description: Filling the square box: the hovering sentry drone with two rotor arms and one lens eye, a chunky laser pistol with teal lens rings slung under its belly.

drill_mole.brief: Asteroid mole wearing the mining pick as a drill helmet. Accent: copper.
drill_mole.description: Filling the square box: the stubby asteroid mole standing up tall on its hind legs, huge diamond claws raised, the meteor-iron mining pick mounted on its snout as a drill with a teal crystal tip, tail jet. One single animal.

medic_drone.brief: Scout drone with a red cross and a wrench arm. Accent: coral red.
medic_drone.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a small round scout drone with a big camera eye in the middle, two long rotor arms reaching out to both ends, a coral red cross on its side, a little arm holding a wrench.

magma_hound.brief: Comet fox grown big with magma newt basalt skin. Accent: coral red.
magma_hound.description: Filling the square box: a lean long-legged hound mid-stride, cracked black basalt skin with coral red heat in the cracks, short swept-back basalt horns and pointed ears, a long tail of drifting ash. One single animal.

snow_lynx.brief: Shadow lynx with frosted fur and ice crystal crest. Accent: teal.
snow_lynx.description: Filling the square box: a crouching lynx with frosted white fur, a crest of teal ice crystals along its spine like the ice ferret, icy ear tufts, pale eyes. One single animal.

hawk_eye_parrot.brief: Lens-beak parrot with a targeting monocle. Accent: coral red.
hawk_eye_parrot.description: The plump Gemell parrot with its coral red lens beak and dish crest, a riveted targeting lens with crosshair worn as a monocle over one eye. One single animal.

jelly_swarm.brief: One big nebula jellyfish with a vacuum slug shell on top. Accent: sage.
jelly_swarm.description: Filling the square box: one big drifting jellyfish, its see-through bell topped by a small dome shell like the hull slug's, a sage nebula swirl inside, long trailing tentacles. One single animal.

beetle_lantern.brief: Glow beetle carrying a Facet crystal as a lamp. Accent: mustard.
beetle_lantern.description: One beetle seen from above, its ringed planet shell, a teal Facet crystal mounted on its back as a lamp, its rear a flat mustard lamp shape. One single animal.

dust_storm.brief: Dust bunny spinning in a dust devil with moth wings. Accent: cream.
dust_storm.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: one grey fluff dust bunny with long ears and pale moth wings, spinning inside a long sideways dust devil of flat swirl lines that reaches from end to end. One single animal.

star_hatchling.brief: Hatchling bursting from a star-speckled egg in royal jelly. Accent: mustard.
star_hatchling.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a small hatchling stretched out sideways breaking out of a long cream constellation egg, mustard royal jelly dripping, its wings two flat star shapes spread wide to both ends. One single animal.

astronaut_ration.brief: Vacuum tray with a moon cheese wedge and a rocket bar. Accent: cream.
astronaut_ration.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long vacuum-sealed meal tray with three compartments in a row, a cratered moon cheese wedge, the rocket-shaped protein bar and a bean paste, foil peeled back at one corner.

fire_jerky.brief: Jerky strip tied round a basalt rocket chili. Accent: coral red.
fire_jerky.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long strip of dark jerky stretched flat, the cracked basalt rocket chili tied to one end with a knot, coral red heat in its cracks, a tiny fin sticking out.

garden_bowl.brief: Hydro lettuce in a bowl with an algae ball floating above. Accent: sage.
garden_bowl.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long shallow hydroponic tray of lettuce leaves in a row, a wobbly sage algae ball floating above one end, the bent straw stuck in the other.

space_burger.brief: Long sub burger with dumpling buns and moon cheese. Accent: mustard.
space_burger.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long sub-style burger, the bun a long plump gravity dumpling, a cratered moon cheese slice and lettuce along its whole length, the top bun hovering slightly above.

chili_noodles.brief: Noodle cup with a rocket chili and noodle planet ring. Accent: coral red.
chili_noodles.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long ration tray of noodles, noodles floating up in curls along it, one forming a planet ring, a basalt rocket chili at one end, chopsticks at the other.

honey_cake.brief: Asteroid-shaped cake dripping honey, crystal candy on top. Accent: mustard.
honey_cake.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long loaf cake shaped like an elongated cratered asteroid, mustard honey drifting off it in floating drops, a teal crystal candy on top.

sundae.brief: Ration cup tower of ice cream brick and comet sorbet. Accent: teal.
sundae.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long dented ration tube lying on its side, a three-layer freeze-dried ice cream brick sliding out of one end, a scoop of comet ice trailing a frozen dust tail to the other.

turbo_cola.brief: Cola squeeze bottle with an energy gel taped on. Accent: coral red.
turbo_cola.description: Upright: the cola squeeze bottle with a coral red starburst label, a mustard lightning-bolt gel pouch taped to its side, fizz bubbles floating up as round outlines.

spore_stew.brief: Pot of stew with mushrooms and dumplings floating above it. Accent: sage.
spore_stew.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long low stew pot like a trough, its lid hovering above, dish-capped sage mushrooms and two plump dumplings floating out along it, spores as small round dots.

candied_fruit.brief: Star fruit on a stick coated in crystal sugar. Accent: mustard.
candied_fruit.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long skewer lying flat with three mustard star fruits in a row, coated in hard teal crystal sugar facets, one point bitten off.

void_beam.brief: Prism laser grown long, a black void in its crystal. Accent: cream.
void_beam.description: Upright through the tall box: a long emitter with three teal lens rings, the Facet crystal at its tip turned to a flat black void with a crisp cream outline.

gatling_laser.brief: Ring of laser barrels around a copper coil battery. Accent: coral red.
gatling_laser.description: Filling the square box: four laser pistol barrels with teal lens rings bundled in a ring like a gatling, a copper-coiled star battery behind them, one double grip.

dragon_engine.brief: Long plasma cutter with a dragon-head nozzle and thruster fins. Accent: coral red.
dragon_engine.description: Running the full length of the long box, end to end: a very long plasma cutter, its nozzle forged as a dragon head with closed jaws and coral red eyes at one end, thruster fins along the whole back, the grip at the other end, no flame.

neutron_hammer.brief: Huge hammer: asteroid slag head around a dense mustard core. Accent: mustard.
neutron_hammer.description: The huge hammer head fills the top four cells: meteor iron and fused asteroid around a small mustard core window, coral red crack shapes; the haft drops down the lower left cell; lower right empty.

absolute_zero.brief: Giant ice cannon crusted with comet ice, snowflake on the barrel. Accent: teal.
absolute_zero.description: Standing tall from the bottom to the top of the box: a massive upright cannon caked in flat teal hexagon ice, a big snowflake emblem on the long barrel pointing up, the coolant tank on its back, a wide frosted base at the bottom.

bloom_artillery.brief: Fungal mortar grown into a cannon covered in blossoms. Accent: sage.
bloom_artillery.description: Filling the whole wide box: a big puffball cannon barrel lying across from edge to edge on a thick root base that reaches the bottom, overgrown with sage mushrooms and pale Murk blossoms, the plague slug curled on top as a living loader. One single animal.

storm_coil.brief: EMP cannon wrapped in a tesla coil, one zig-zag arc. Accent: mustard.
storm_coil.description: Filling the square box: the ring-barrel EMP cannon wrapped in a tall copper tesla coil, the running microchip on its side, one flat mustard zig-zag arc jumping to the jammer dish.

citadel_plating.brief: Wall of riveted bulkhead plates with a dish on top. Accent: copper.
citadel_plating.description: Filling the whole wide box: a wall of overlapping riveted bulkhead plates reaching all four edges, X braces across it, the old satellite dish mounted on top as a shield turret, copper bolts.

life_support_suit.brief: Exo torso with a tube backpack and a heartbeat screen. Accent: sage.
life_support_suit.description: A suit's upper body in a riveted exo frame fills the top left cells to the top and left edges; a big medkit backpack with sage tubes fills the top right cell; a fat ribbed oxygen tank hangs on a short hose and fills the whole lower left cell; a heartbeat screen on the chest; lower right cell empty.

star_piercer.brief: Railgun rails stretched long with a crystal sniper scope. Accent: mustard.
star_piercer.description: Running the full length of the long box, end to end: two very long parallel teal docking rails, a crystal sniper scope on top, a fat capacitor at one end, a star-shaped mustard muzzle cap at the other.

captains_dinner.brief: Tray with a domed dish, ration and jerky, star napkin. Accent: cream.
captains_dinner.description: Filling the square box: an oval tray with a half-lifted dome lid, the ration pack and a knot of jerky beside it, a napkin folded like a star, straps holding it all down.

solar_drake.brief: Winged drake with a sun-flare frill, basalt and gold. Accent: mustard.
solar_drake.description: Filling the square box: a winged drake with cracked basalt skin, a big mustard frill around its neck shaped like flat sun flares, curry-red belly. One single animal.

titan_crab.brief: Giant crab with a telescope mirror shield as its shell. Accent: copper.
titan_crab.description: Filling the whole wide box: a giant squat sandstone crab with its legs spread wide to both sides, the round telescope mirror shield with a reflected ringed planet as its shell, periscope eyes, two big crystal claws reaching to the edges. One single animal.

glacier_drake.brief: Long drake with ice-plated back and ferret crystal crest. Accent: teal.
glacier_drake.description: Filling the square box: a long coiled drake with teal comet-ice plates down its back, a crest of ice crystals, frost breath as a small flat cloud. One single animal.

command_drone.brief: Big drone with antennas, a laser gun and a medic cross. Accent: coral red.
command_drone.description: Filling the whole wide box: a big hovering drone with four long rotor arms reaching to the corners, a tall antenna mast, a laser pistol slung below, a coral red medic cross on its side, one big lens eye.

grand_buffet.brief: Long strapped table with honey cake and chili noodles. Accent: mustard.
grand_buffet.description: Filling the wide box: a long table with magnet feet, the asteroid honey cake and chili noodle cup on it, bowls and fruit, all held down by straps so nothing floats away.

aegis_fortress.brief: Tiny fortress of shield plates with a dish tower. Accent: teal.
aegis_fortress.description: Filling the whole tall box edge to edge: a block-shaped fortress of stacked riveted shield plates, its walls running straight up the left and right edges, flat teal force panels between them, a satellite dish tower on the flat roof at the top edge.

plague_hydra.brief: Three-headed serpent with crystal fangs and jelly frills. Accent: sage.
plague_hydra.description: Three long necks fill the upper four cells, the heads reaching the top corners; the thick body coils only inside the lower left cell, down to the bottom edge; nothing in the lower right. Crystal fangs dripping sage venom, see-through jelly frills. One single animal.

inferno_blade.brief: Plasma katana with twin fuel cans on its guard. Accent: coral red.
inferno_blade.description: Upright through the tall box: the slim curved coral red plasma blade grown longer, flat flame shapes licking along its edge, the two welded fuel cans mounted as its guard.

worldbreaker.brief: Hammer whose head is a small dark planet with a ring. Accent: coral red.
worldbreaker.description: Upright through the tall box: a giant hammer whose head is a small dark planet with a coral red cracked crust and one ring, debris orbiting, the heavy haft wrapped in leather.

death_blossom.brief: Gun barrels arranged like flower petals around a void. Accent: coral red.
death_blossom.description: Filling the whole wide box: many long laser barrels with teal lens rings fanned out like flower petals reaching all edges, a flat black void with cream outline at the centre, a short stem grip below.

phoenix.brief: Fire bird rising from a star fruit, star-dust tail. Accent: coral red.
phoenix.description: Filling the square box: a bird of flat coral red and mustard flame shapes rising with wings spread, a five-pointed star crest, a long tail of stardust specks. No glow. One single animal.

entropy_engine.brief: Machine half frozen and half overgrown, a cannon in the middle. Accent: sage.
entropy_engine.description: The machine fills all but the lower right cell: left half crusted in teal ice like Absolute Zero, right half overgrown with sage mushrooms and blossoms, one big cannon barrel through the middle.

dyson_bastion.brief: Fortress wall of curved panels around a tiny star. Accent: mustard.
dyson_bastion.description: Filling the square box: a ring fortress of curved armour panels with mustard panel grids on the inside, a tiny star in its middle as a flat mustard shape, a dish turret on top.

leviathan.brief: Huge space beast: crab-armoured head, kraken tentacles. Accent: teal.
leviathan.description: Filling the square box: a huge beast, its head armoured with a cracked sandstone crab shell and mirror plate, one big teal eye, thick tentacles with cream suckers coiling out below. One single animal.

med_bay.brief: Small medical cabinet with an IV bag and a scrubber fan. Accent: coral red.
med_bay.description: A wide medical cabinet fills the whole top row, coral red cross on the door, an IV bag floating on a tether; only in the lower left cell a scrubber unit with a fan grille; nothing in the lower right.

shield_capacitor.brief: Shield battery with a star power cell clipped on. Accent: teal.
shield_capacitor.description: Upright: the fat shield battery with its hexagon dome top and charge bars, a star-window power cell clipped to its side, all three bars filled teal.

trauma_kit.brief: Red medical bag with a cross, an oxygen bottle strapped on. Accent: coral red.
trauma_kit.description: Standing tall from the bottom to the top of the box: a tall coral red medical backpack with a cream cross patch, the long teal oxygen bottle with its round gauge strapped down its side, a mask hanging off the strap.

panacea.brief: Long antitoxin pen with moss growing in its chamber. Accent: sage.
panacea.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long antitoxin injector pen lying flat, a window of thick sage liquid along its body, medi moss with tiny star flowers growing from its cap end.

caretaker_bot.brief: Repair bot with a filter mask face and a towel arm. Accent: cream.
caretaker_bot.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a small round robot in the middle with a sage air-filter mask as its face, one long wrench arm reaching to one end, the other arm holding out a long unfolded towel to the other.

survival_suit.brief: Suit torso wrapped in a crinkled mustard foil blanket. Accent: mustard.
survival_suit.description: Filling the square box: only the upper body of a space suit, no legs, wrapped in the crinkled foil rescue blanket like a cape, hard mustard and cream foil facets, the helmet hanging at its side.

power_meal.brief: Lunch box with a rocket protein bar and planet pills. Accent: mustard.
power_meal.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long open lunch box, the rocket-shaped protein bar lying along one half, a long blister strip of tiny ringed-planet pills along the other.

sanctuary.brief: Small domed shrine with a moon-rock spring inside. Accent: teal.
sanctuary.description: Standing tall from the bottom to the top of the box: a tall domed shrine of pale moon rock with a high round door, the healing spring inside rising as floating teal balls, a coral red cross over the door, sage moss on its wide base.

protein_bar.brief: Ration bar shaped like a rocket, nose bitten off. Accent: copper.
protein_bar.description: A ration bar shaped like a small rocket with stubby fins, its nose bitten off, the copper wrapper peeled back at the tail. No text.

moon_cheese.brief: Cheese wheel shaped like a cratered mini moon with a crumb in orbit. Accent: mustard.
moon_cheese.description: A small cheese wheel shaped like a cratered mini moon, one wedge cut out showing the pale inside, a single crumb orbiting it like a tiny moon. Mustard rind.

ice_cream.brief: Freeze-dried ice cream brick shedding floating square crumbs. Accent: coral red.
ice_cream.description: Upright: a freeze-dried ice cream brick in torn foil, three coloured layers with the top one coral red, a few square crumbs floating off it.

algae_shake.brief: Algae shake rising out of its cup as a floating ball. Accent: sage.
algae_shake.description: Upright: a squeeze cup with a bent straw, the sage algae shake rising out of it as a wobbly floating ball.

hydro_lettuce.brief: Lettuce in a domed hydroponic cup, roots in a water ball. Accent: sage.
hydro_lettuce.description: A sage lettuce head growing in a small hydroponic cup with a clear dome lid, its roots hanging below in a floating ball of water.

mushroom_cluster.brief: Three Murk mushrooms with dish-shaped caps all turned one way. Accent: sage.
mushroom_cluster.description: Three small mushrooms from the fog planet Murk growing from one clump, their sage caps shaped like little satellite dishes, all turned the same way.

gravity_dumplings.brief: Two dumplings hovering above their bowl. Accent: copper.
gravity_dumplings.description: Two plump dumplings hovering just above their small bowl, a short shadow gap between them and the bowl.

energy_gel.brief: Squeeze pouch with a bolt, gel squeezing out as a floating blob. Accent: mustard.
energy_gel.description: A squeeze pouch with a mustard lightning bolt on it and a twist cap, a blob of gel floating out of the open top.

cosmic_egg.brief: Speckled egg whose spots form a constellation. Accent: cream.
cosmic_egg.description: A cream egg whose dark speckles form a small constellation joined by thin lines, a hairline crack near the top.

rocket_chili.brief: Basalt-skinned lava chili with rocket fins. Accent: coral red.
rocket_chili.description: A chili from a lava planet: cracked black basalt skin with coral red heat in the cracks as flat colour, stubby rocket fins at the stem.

space_noodles.brief: Noodle cup with noodles floating out, one curl a planet ring. Accent: copper.
space_noodles.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long ration tray of noodles, the noodles floating up out of it in loose curls along its whole length, one curl forming a ring like a planet's, chopsticks stuck in one end.

star_fruit.brief: Star-shaped fruit cut open, seeds in a spiral galaxy. Accent: mustard.
star_fruit.description: A five-pointed mustard star fruit cut in half, the cut face showing its seeds arranged like a small spiral galaxy.

nova_cola.brief: Cola squeeze bottle with a starburst label, bubbles floating. Accent: coral red.
nova_cola.description: Upright: a cola squeeze bottle with a coral red starburst label without text, fizz bubbles leaving the neck and floating away as round outlines.

crystal_candy.brief: Hard candy shaped like a Facet crystal on a stick. Accent: teal.
crystal_candy.description: A hard candy shaped like a teal crystal from the planet Facet, on a stick, a small bite missing from one facet.

comet_sorbet.brief: Scoop of comet ice in a cup, dust tail streaming off it. Accent: teal.
comet_sorbet.description: A scoop of dirty comet ice in a dented ration cup, a long tail of frozen dust streaming off it as if still flying, a spoon on a tether cord.

asteroid_honey.brief: Asteroid-shaped honey jar, honey drifting out in drops. Accent: mustard.
asteroid_honey.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long lumpy honey jar shaped like an elongated asteroid lying on its side, mustard honey drifting out of its open end in floating drops, a dipper tethered at the other end.

magma_curry.brief: Curry bubbling like a lava field in a bowl. Accent: coral red.
magma_curry.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long oval serving dish of curry bubbling like a lava field, black crust cracking over coral red sauce, a spoon resting along it.

royal_jelly.brief: Round jar of jelly with a planet ring and a crown lid. Accent: mustard.
royal_jelly.description: A small round jar of thick mustard jelly with a ring around it like a planet's ring and a tiny crown on the lid.

captains_banquet.brief: Huge strapped-down banquet tray under a half-lifted dome lid. Accent: copper.
captains_banquet.description: Filling the wide box: a huge oval tray with a roast under a half-lifted dome lid, fruit, bread and a small moon cheese around it, everything held down by little straps so nothing floats away. Copper rim.

antitoxin.brief: Syringe pen with a dose window and a magnet clip. Accent: sage.
antitoxin.description: A small syringe pen with a sage cap, a little window showing the dose and a magnet clip on its side.

medi_moss.brief: Moss in a petri dish, the lid floating above it. Accent: sage.
medi_moss.description: A clump of soft sage moss with tiny star-shaped flowers in a petri dish, its lid floating just above it.

vitamin_pack.brief: Blister pack of pills shaped like tiny ringed planets. Accent: coral red.
vitamin_pack.description: A blister pack of round pills, each pill a tiny coral red planet with a ring, two already pushed out.

bone_broth.brief: Mug of broth with a chunk of comet ice melting in it. Accent: copper.
bone_broth.description: A copper mug of broth with a sip lid, a chunk of comet ice melting in it, steam drawn as wavy ink lines.

life_orchid.brief: Heart-petalled orchid under a small pressure dome. Accent: coral red.
life_orchid.description: Standing tall from the bottom to the top of the box: a tall orchid stem in a small pot under a tall clear pressure dome, a column of heart-shaped coral red petals climbing up the stem.

seed_pod.brief: Hard seed pod split along a seam with a specimen tag. Accent: sage.
seed_pod.description: A hard ridged seed pod from the fog planet Murk, split open along one seam like a small hatch, a paper specimen tag from Venn's lab tied to its stem.

watering_drone.brief: The botanist's old round drone, spout forward. Accent: teal.
watering_drone.description: Standing tall from the bottom to the top of the box: the botanist's old watering drone hovering upright, its round dented body at the top, a long spout pointing down, a long landing leg with a green vine wound round it reaching the bottom.

compost_bin.brief: Zero-g lab bin, peels floating out round it. Accent: sage.
compost_bin.description: A sealed station lab bin, its lid forced open by tendrils, peels and leaves drifting out in zero gravity and circling the rim.

thornvine.brief: Long hooked vine with a strip of suit fabric. Accent: sage.
thornvine.description: Running the full length of the long box, end to end: a long vine with hooked black thorns stretched out straight, gently waving, a torn strip of Venn's suit fabric caught on one thorn.

pollen_cloud.brief: Cracked seed bulb leaking a pollen galaxy. Accent: mustard.
pollen_cloud.description: A cracked pale seed bulb like those in Venn's visor, mustard pollen grains drifting out and swirling round it in a small spiral like a galaxy.

grow_lamp.brief: Folding solar-panel grow lamp with a tendril. Accent: mustard.
grow_lamp.description: A small grow lamp made from a folded satellite solar panel on a jointed arm, flat mustard light lines below, one pink-tipped green tendril curling up towards it.

venus_mantrap.brief: Snapping offshoot of Venn, jaws on a stem. Accent: coral red.
venus_mantrap.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a snapping offshoot of Venn in side view, a long green tendril stem from a specimen tag at one end to wide open toothy jaws at the other, coral red inside the jaws, no eyes.

moon_melon.brief: Pale cratered melon like a little moon. Accent: sage.
moon_melon.description: Filling the square box: a big pale melon shaped like a cratered moon, one slice cut out showing pink flesh, a slice-crumb orbiting it, green tendrils with pink tips and a specimen tag on the stalk.

healing_moss.brief: Soft moss in a floating petri dish. Accent: sage.
healing_moss.description: A pad of soft sage moss with tiny star-shaped flowers in a cracked petri dish, a small water ball floating above it.

root_network.brief: Roots cracking through station pipes. Accent: copper.
root_network.description: Running the full length of the long box, end to end: one very long straight copper station pipe, roots bursting out of cracks along its whole length, small pale root tips reaching out of every joint.

carnivorous_orchid.brief: Orchid with a toothed mouth among petals. Accent: coral red.
carnivorous_orchid.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a pink Murk orchid on a long curved stem, a bent lab clamp at one end, the bloom at the other, petals like a lure round a toothed mouth with a coral red throat, no eyes.

spore_mine.brief: Seed Pod sprouting mushroom caps, about to burst. Accent: sage.
spore_mine.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: the split Seed Pod swollen long like a spiked cigar-shaped sea mine, dish-capped mushrooms growing all along its seam, a specimen tag at one end.

giant_mantrap.brief: Huge offshoot with several snapping jaws. Accent: coral red.
giant_mantrap.description: The three jaws fill the whole top row edge to edge; one thick coiled stem drops straight down the lower left cell to the bottom edge; nothing in the lower right. A huge offshoot, coral red jaws, wet biogel as flat drops, no eyes.

harvest_crate.brief: Station crate overflowing with odd vegetables. Accent: copper.
harvest_crate.description: Filling the square box: a riveted station supply crate with magnet corners, overflowing with alien vegetables and the cratered Moon Melon, the compost bin's tendrils pushing through the slats.

briar_fortress.brief: Thorny arch around a bent station door frame. Accent: sage.
briar_fortress.description: An arch of thick thorny branches: the whole top row is the lintel reaching both ends, the two lower corner cells are slim posts going straight down, the two middle lower cells stay plain like an open doorway. The bent frame of a station airlock door shows through; roots grip the posts; pale seed bulbs hang in the thorns.

hydra_bloom.brief: Three snapping flower heads on tendril stems. Accent: coral red.
hydra_bloom.description: The three snapping flower heads fill the upper four cells edge to edge; the stems gather into one bundle that drops straight down the lower left cell to the bottom edge; nothing in the lower right. One head is the pink orchid, coral red jaws, no eyes.

irrigation_swarm.brief: One sprinkler drone with a lamp and pollen. Accent: teal.
irrigation_swarm.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: one long watering drone in side view with a row of spray nozzles under its long belly, the folded solar-panel grow lamp on its back, mustard pollen drifting from a cracked bulb at one end.

world_seed.brief: Split seed with a tiny moss planet inside. Accent: sage.
world_seed.description: Filling the square box: a large seed split open, rough bark and long thorns bursting out of the crack, a tiny moss-green planet with one ring floating between them.

queen_spore.brief: Big seed bulb crowned by small bulbs. Accent: sage.
queen_spore.description: A large pale seed bulb like those in Venn's visor, crowned by a ring of smaller swollen bulbs, a few round spores floating round it like moons.

terrarium_heart.brief: Long lab terrarium cracked by tendrils, a heart inside. Accent: sage.
terrarium_heart.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long lab terrarium box with a riveted metal frame and air valve, a heart-shaped moss plant inside, its glass cracked by pink-tipped tendrils pushing out at both ends.

bramble_seed.brief: Spiky seed in a specimen vial. Accent: sage.
bramble_seed.description: A small spiky seed in a specimen vial from Venn's lab, black thorns pushing the cork half out.

sap_tap.brief: Lab tap in bark, sap floating as balls. Accent: mustard.
sap_tap.description: A lab tap driven into a piece of bark, mustard sap leaving it as floating round balls in zero gravity, one caught in a small beaker.

snap_sprout.brief: Tiny biting sprout in a seed tray cell. Accent: sage.
snap_sprout.description: A tiny sprout with a biting mouth poking out of one cell of a seed tray, two small leaves like arms, no eyes.

bark_shield.brief: Long oval bark shield with a suit patch grown in. Accent: copper.
bark_shield.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long oval shield of thick bark grown round a hull plate, lying sideways, a patch from Venn's suit grown into the middle, small shoots at both ends.

nectar_flask.brief: Lab flask of nectar with a leaf cork. Accent: mustard.
nectar_flask.description: Upright: a round-bottomed lab flask of golden nectar, a leaf pushed into the neck as a cork, one nectar drop floating up as a ball.

blight_bomb.brief: Rotten fruit bomb with a stem fuse. Accent: sage.
blight_bomb.description: A rotten swollen alien fruit with dark spots, a dried stem as a fuse, sage fumes curling off it as flat wavy shapes.

strangler_fig.brief: Fig vines strangling a bent station pipe. Accent: sage.
strangler_fig.description: Running the full length of the long box, end to end: a long straight station coolant pipe, fig vines coiling tightly round its whole length until it bends, frost crust where it has burst, roots knotted round the joints at both ends.

ironbark_golem.brief: Hulking golem of bark and asteroid stones. Accent: copper.
ironbark_golem.description: Filling the square box: a small hulking golem of bark and asteroid stones, a pale seed bulb where a head should be, no face, moss on its shoulders.

sun_blossom.brief: Big flower with petals like a sun corona. Accent: mustard.
sun_blossom.description: Filling the square box: a big flower whose petals form a sun corona in mustard and coral red, its centre a cluster of pale seed bulbs like those in Venn's visor.

thorn_pod.brief: Seed Pod covered in hooked thorns. Accent: sage.
thorn_pod.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: the split Murk Seed Pod stretched long like a spiked bean pod, hooked black thorns from the Bramble Seed all along it, the cracked vial stuck on one end.

mantrap_pack.brief: One snapping offshoot with two jaws in one pot. Accent: sage.
mantrap_pack.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: one snapping offshoot in a long cracked lab trough, two toothy heads on stems reaching out to opposite ends, no eyes, coral red inside the jaws. One single animal.

living_armor.brief: Suit chest plate overgrown with bark. Accent: sage.
living_armor.description: Filling the square box edge to edge: a space-suit chest plate with both shoulder pieces, overgrown with bark and thorny vines that spill over every side, seams split open, small pale seed pods in the vines.

jungle_tyrant.brief: Huge plant beast of jaws and vine arms. Accent: sage.
jungle_tyrant.description: Filling the whole wide box: a monstrous plant beast stretched wide, vine arms reaching to both sides, the Strangler Fig's roots as legs gripping a bent station pipe along the bottom, three coral red jaws, no eyes, a torn suit glove on one vine. One single animal.

ambrosia.brief: Bowl of nectar with floating moss leaves. Accent: mustard.
ambrosia.description: Filling the square box: a lab bowl of golden nectar, the liquid rising off it as floating balls, moss leaves with tiny star flowers drifting inside.

plague_blossom.brief: Sickly flower held out like a gift. Accent: sage.
plague_blossom.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a sickly flower lying on its side on a long stem, a rotten fruit bulb tied at one end, the flower head at the other, sage toxic pollen puffing from it as flat wavy clouds.

space_pup.brief: Shaggy herd pup with a comet tail. Accent: mustard.
space_pup.description: Standing tall from the bottom to the top of the box: a young herd pup sitting up tall, head at the top, oversized paws at the bottom, shaggy mustard fur, a stubby horn on its forehead, its bushy comet tail curling up its side.

treat_pouch.brief: Woven grass pouch spilling berries. Accent: copper.
treat_pouch.description: A small pouch woven from grass by the herd, open at the top, round alien berries floating out of it, a tuft of shed fur on the knot.

pet_bed.brief: Round woven nest padded with shed fur. Accent: coral red.
pet_bed.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long oval nest woven from twigs and padded with shed fur, a long dent in the middle where an animal slept, a coral red woven band round the rim.

pack_lizard.brief: Long low herd lizard with bundles on its back. Accent: sage.
pack_lizard.description: Filling the whole square box: a big heavy lizard from a heavy-gravity planet, seen side-on and rearing up so its head reaches the top, six thick legs on the bottom edge, flat layered rock scales, tall woven bundles tied on its back, a calm heavy-lidded eye.

kibble_sack.brief: Woven sack of dried seeds and roots. Accent: copper.
kibble_sack.description: Standing tall from the bottom to the top of the box: a tall woven sack of dried star-shaped seeds and roots, tied at the top with a braided cord, a tuft of fur on the knot, a few seeds floating out of the top.

burrow_rat.brief: Rat with asteroid-plate armour and crystal teeth. Accent: copper.
burrow_rat.description: A rat peeking out of a round hole in a small asteroid, its back armoured with grey rock plates, strong digging claws and two big teal crystal front teeth.

hatchery.brief: Salvaged incubator with a woven nest of eggs. Accent: mustard.
hatchery.description: Filling the square box: a dented salvaged incubator box with a heater coil and a dial, its broken lid replaced by a woven nest of round speckled eggs, half covered by shed fur, cords tying the nest to the metal.

star_falcon.brief: Falcon diving with star-speckled wings. Accent: mustard.
star_falcon.description: Upright: a falcon diving head-first, wings folded back like a comet, wing tips speckled with small mustard stars, a faint dust trail behind it.

calling_shell.brief: Spiral shell on a braided cord. Accent: copper.
calling_shell.description: A spiral shell from a tide planet on a braided cord, its spiral shaped like a small galaxy, its mouth worn smooth from humming into it.

tusked_behemoth.brief: Quill's huge shaggy mount with four tusks. Accent: copper.
tusked_behemoth.description: Quill's mount, the same beast as in the hero design. A huge low shaggy body filling the box sideways, four curved tusks under a heavy brow, tiny eyes, an empty woven nest between its horns, matted fur in heavy clumps, moss and small stones caught in it.

hive_queen.brief: One furry insect queen with a crown head. Accent: mustard.
hive_queen.description: Filling the square box: one big furry insect queen seen from above, her head shaped like a crown, folded wings like solar sails, a striped body, alone.

star_hound.brief: Space Pup grown into a star-speckled hound. Accent: teal.
star_hound.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: the Space Pup grown into a long shaggy hound in side view, stretched mid-stride from nose to tail, the Burrow Rat's long teal crystal teeth, rock plates along its back, star-speckled teal fur.

sun_eagle.brief: Star Falcon grown into a sun-crested eagle. Accent: mustard.
sun_eagle.description: Upside-down L: the eagle perches in the lower left cell, talons at the bottom edge, body at the left edge; both spread wings sweep right across the whole top row; nothing in the lower right. Sun-ray crest, a lens over one eye.

cozy_den.brief: Den dug into a small asteroid, lined with fur. Accent: coral red.
cozy_den.description: Filling the square box: a den dug into a small round asteroid, lined with shed fur, the woven Pet Bed visible inside and the Kibble Sack leaning at the entrance.

shell_dragon.brief: Pack Lizard grown big with a crab shell. Accent: copper.
shell_dragon.description: Filling the square box: the Pack Lizard grown into a big heavy dragon with the Rock Crab's lumpy asteroid shell on its back, moss on top, six thick legs planted wide.

celestial_chimera.brief: Beast with a hound mane, eagle wings and star tail. Accent: mustard.
celestial_chimera.description: The body fills the upper four cells, the star tail drops into the lower left; the lower right stays empty. A beast with the Star Hound's wild mane and the Sun Eagle's wings, its tail ending in a small flat star.

rat_pack.brief: One long burrow rat with a big seed and a thick tail. Accent: copper.
rat_pack.description: Stretched end to end across the long box: one fat Burrow Rat in side view, rock plates on its back, crystal teeth gnawing a big seed at the front end, its thick plated tail running out to the far end.

elder_tusk.brief: Cracked old tusk tip on a braided cord. Accent: coral red.
elder_tusk.description: The cracked tip of an old herd tusk on a braided cord, scratched with herd marks and a small star map, a coral red bead on the cord.

herd_heart.brief: Long meteorite stone wrapped in braided fur. Accent: mustard.
herd_heart.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long smooth meteorite stone lying flat, wrapped round in braided fur bands, scratched with a row of simple herd animal outlines, a small heart shape carved in the middle.

ancient_egg.brief: Huge carved stone egg, one claw breaking out. Accent: cream.
ancient_egg.description: Filling the square box: a large stone egg with old carvings spiralling round it like orbits, cracked open at the top where one small claw pushes out.

feeding_bowl.brief: Half shell used as a bowl of berries. Accent: coral red.
feeding_bowl.description: The hollow half of a big alien shell used as a bowl, filled with coral red berries and roots, one berry floating above it.

guard_goose.brief: Angry goose with frost-feather wings. Accent: cream.
guard_goose.description: Standing tall from the bottom to the top of the box: an angry goose from an ice planet standing tall, neck stretched straight up with beak open in a hiss at the top, frosted wings raised, wide snowshoe feet at the bottom.

grooming_comb.brief: Wide bone comb with shed fur. Accent: coral red.
grooming_comb.description: A wide bone comb with tufts of shed fur caught in its teeth, a coral red cord on its handle.

war_saddle.brief: Woven saddle pad with tusk-tip studs. Accent: copper.
war_saddle.description: A woven saddle pad padded with fur, tusk tips as studs along the edge, braided straps hanging down.

moon_bear.brief: Big shaggy bear with a crescent mark. Accent: cream.
moon_bear.description: Filling the square box: a big shaggy bear from a moon with long nights, sitting up, a cream crescent mark on its chest, huge pale night eyes, a heavy brow.

glow_swarm.brief: One firefly with a big lit tail. Accent: mustard.
glow_swarm.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: one long furry firefly from a dark planet in side view, head at one end, its long tail a flat mustard lamp reaching the other end, wings like solar sails along its back.

thunder_ram.brief: Ram with sparks crackling between horns. Accent: mustard.
thunder_ram.description: Filling the square box: a ram from a storm planet lowering its head, curled horns, flat mustard zig-zag sparks between them, a shaggy coat standing on end.

nursery.brief: Salvaged warming cradle with one sleeping pup. Accent: mustard.
nursery.description: Filling the square box: an old rocking warming cradle of riveted metal with a heater vent and a crank, padded with woven grass and shed fur by the herd, one young pup asleep inside, ears sticking out.

sky_serpent.brief: Long flying serpent with a mane, like a comet. Accent: teal.
sky_serpent.description: Running the full length of the long box, end to end: one very long serpent stretched straight through space, head at one end and tail tip at the other, solar-sail fins along its whole back, a shaggy mane, teal scales. One single animal.

guard_hound.brief: Space Pup grown into a hound standing guard. Accent: coral red.
