guard_hound.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: the Space Pup grown into a long hound in side view standing guard, nose at one end and tail at the other, teeth bared, the Guard Goose's frosted feathers tucked in its collar of fur.

armored_bear.brief: Moon Bear wearing the War Saddle and plates. Accent: copper.
armored_bear.description: Filling the square box: the Moon Bear wearing the woven War Saddle, plates of bark and bone strapped round its chest, the crescent mark still showing.

juggernaut.brief: Tusked Behemoth charging with ram horns. Accent: coral red.
juggernaut.description: Filling the wide box: the Tusked Behemoth charging with the Thunder Ram's curled horns, flat mustard sparks between them, dust kicked up as flat strokes.

banquet_trough.brief: Long hollow log full of berries and seeds. Accent: copper.
banquet_trough.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a very long hollow log lying flat from end to end, filled with berries, roots and star-shaped seeds, the alien Feeding Bowl's shell at one end.

swarm_cloud.brief: Hive Queen in a swirl of dust and dots. Accent: mustard.
swarm_cloud.description: Filling the square box: the Hive Queen with her crown-shaped head flying in the middle of a spiral of flat mustard dots like a small galaxy, alone.

pack_bond.brief: Two braided fur cords knotted together. Accent: coral red.
pack_bond.description: Two braided fur cords knotted together, the spiral Calling Shell on one end and a coral red bead on the other.

welding_arm.brief: One of Rook's tool legs as a welding arm. Accent: mustard.
welding_arm.description: Upright: one of Rook's six tool legs as a spare part, a jointed metal limb with a welding torch at the top end, its tip hot coral red, mismatched patch plates, a loose cable along the joint, a magnet foot at the bottom.

spare_parts.brief: Little hoard of floating gears and bolts. Accent: copper.
spare_parts.description: A little hoard of gears, bolts and a spring held together by one twist of wire, a few loose bolts floating round it in zero gravity.

circuit_board.brief: Satellite circuit board, one corner burnt. Accent: sage.
circuit_board.description: A circuit board pulled out of a satellite, chips and traces in sage, one corner burnt black, a tiny solar cell still stuck on it.

conveyor_belt.brief: Short conveyor belt pieced from wreck parts. Accent: copper.
conveyor_belt.description: Lying across the box: a short conveyor belt pieced together from wreck parts, rollers of different sizes, magnet strips holding one bolt on the belt.

toolbox.brief: Dented toolbox with magnet feet. Accent: coral red.
toolbox.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long low coral red toolbox on magnet feet, one hinge replaced with a twist of wire, a long handle with a tether clip so it cannot drift away.

magnet_crane.brief: Crane arm with a big horseshoe magnet. Accent: coral red.
magnet_crane.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long crane arm from a station dock lying sideways, its base at one end, a big coral red horseshoe magnet hanging at the other with a scrap hull plate and two bolts stuck to it.

junk_cannon.brief: Cannon built from pipes and a fuel tank. Accent: copper.
junk_cannon.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long cannon built from station pipes, an empty fuel tank as the breech at one end, the open pipe muzzle at the other, held with clamps, a copper wire coil at the breech.

recycler.brief: Boxy scrap machine with a lamp eye. Accent: sage.
recycler.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long low scrap machine, a hopper on top at one end, a small mustard lamp on its front like Rook's lantern eye, neat cubes of pressed scrap coming out of a chute at the other end.

tesla_coil.brief: Tower of salvaged wire coils with a ball on top. Accent: mustard.
tesla_coil.description: Upright: a tower of salvaged copper wire coils on a satellite base, a metal ball on top, flat mustard zig-zag sparks around the ball.

assembly_core.brief: Cube core with tool arms folded round it. Accent: mustard.
assembly_core.description: A cube core with small tool arms folding round it like Rook's legs, a claw, a drill and a wrench, a mustard lamp on top.

plasma_welder.brief: Welding Arm rebuilt into a welding gun. Accent: teal.
plasma_welder.description: Upright: Rook's Welding Arm rebuilt into a welding gun, the torch tip hot teal, a guard bent from a scrap hull plate at the grip.

scrap_howitzer.brief: Big welded scrap gun on a satellite housing. Accent: copper.
scrap_howitzer.description: Filling the square box: a big gun of welded scrap with a funnel barrel, bolted to a curved piece of satellite housing like Rook's shell, copper wire around the breech.

logic_core.brief: Salvaged chip with a power cell taped on. Accent: teal.
logic_core.description: A salvaged chip with a star-window power cell taped on, a round sticker shaped like Rook's lantern eye, teal traces.

salvage_rig.brief: Magnet Crane welded on top of the Recycler. Accent: coral red.
salvage_rig.description: Filling the square box: the Magnet Crane welded on top of the Recycler, a scrap plate hanging from the magnet, the mustard lamp-eye still on the front.

arc_forge.brief: Plasma Welder wrapped in Tesla Coil wire. Accent: mustard.
arc_forge.description: Filling the square box: the Plasma Welder wrapped in the Tesla Coil's copper wire, its tip hot teal, flat mustard sparks as ink zig-zags between the coils.

factory_line.brief: Conveyor belt with tool arms and a toolbox. Accent: copper.
factory_line.description: Running the full length of the long box, end to end: a long conveyor belt with two of Rook's spare tool arms bolted above it, the coral red Toolbox at the far end, parts lined up along the whole belt.

master_blueprint.brief: Rolled blueprint showing a satellite shell. Accent: teal.
master_blueprint.description: A rolled teal blueprint half open, showing the outline of a satellite shell like Rook's, a pencil tucked into the roll, a magnet holding the corner.

perpetual_engine.brief: Engine with a flywheel from three wrecks. Accent: copper.
perpetual_engine.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long engine lying flat, a big flywheel at one end, a tiny star in a glass jar as fuel at the other, patched together from three wrecks, each part a different metal.

nanite_swarm.brief: Cube built of tiny bolt-sized robots. Accent: teal.
nanite_swarm.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long rough bar built of tiny bolt-sized robots, each with a little round satellite shell, a few breaking off at one end like crumbs.

capacitor_bank.brief: Three fat capacitors on a scrap board. Accent: mustard.
capacitor_bank.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: four fat salvaged capacitors in a long row on a long scrap board, mustard bands round each, a flat zig-zag spark jumping between two.

bolt_thrower.brief: Small crossbow built from a tool leg. Accent: copper.
bolt_thrower.description: Standing tall from the bottom to the top of the box: a tall upright crossbow built from one of Rook's long tool legs, bow arms cut from a satellite antenna at the top, a copper wire string, the grip at the bottom, nothing loaded.

grav_clamp.brief: Heavy clamp from a docking arm. Accent: teal.
grav_clamp.description: A heavy clamp taken from a station docking arm, teal gravity rings drawn round its jaws.

shield_emitter.brief: Small dish emitter with a ring of force. Accent: teal.
shield_emitter.description: A small emitter cut from a satellite antenna like the ones on Rook's shell, a flat teal ring of force in front of it.

turbo_fan.brief: Wreck cooling fan with bent copper blades. Accent: copper.
turbo_fan.description: A cooling fan from a ship wreck with bent copper blades in a square frame, one blade replaced by a piece of solar panel.

scrap_golem.brief: Walking scrap robot with a lantern eye. Accent: copper.
scrap_golem.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long low walking robot in side view, a fuel tank body lying sideways, a single mustard lantern eye at one end like Rook's, four mismatched magnet-foot legs.

rail_driver.brief: Long rail gun from two salvaged rails. Accent: copper.
rail_driver.description: Along the long box: a long rail gun made from two salvaged copper docking rails, bound together with wire and clamps, a fat capacitor at the back.

bastion_frame.brief: Heavy hull-plate armour like a big shell. Accent: copper.
bastion_frame.description: Filling the square box: a heavy armour frame of hull plates and heat-shield tiles, shaped like a bigger satellite shell for Rook, a porthole in the middle.

quantum_forge.brief: Anvil inside an atom-shaped cage of rails. Accent: mustard.
quantum_forge.description: Filling the square box: an anvil cut from a hull block inside an atom-shaped cage of bent docking rails, a tiny mustard star as the nucleus above the anvil.

rivet_cannon.brief: Rivet gun on a three-legged stand. Accent: copper.
rivet_cannon.description: Standing tall from the bottom to the top of the box: a big rivet gun pointing straight up on a tall three-legged stand, legs taken from the Bolt Thrower and the Welding Arm reaching the bottom, a long belt of rivets hanging down.

dynamo.brief: Generator drum with the Turbo Fan on its side. Accent: mustard.
dynamo.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long generator lying flat, a big drum in the middle, the Turbo Fan at one end, the Capacitor Bank wired on at the other.

bulwark_array.brief: Row of dish emitters on the Bastion Frame. Accent: teal.
bulwark_array.description: Filling the square box: three dish emitters on the hull-plate Bastion Frame, flat teal rings of force overlapping in front.

storm_driver.brief: Rail Driver with the Dynamo strapped under it. Accent: mustard.
storm_driver.description: The rail gun runs along the whole top row from end to end; a squat battery box hangs only inside the lower left cell, down to the bottom edge; nothing below the middle and right cells. The Rail Driver with the Dynamo strapped under it, flat mustard sparks round the rails.

junk_titan.brief: Huge scrap robot with a satellite shell. Accent: copper.
junk_titan.description: Filling the square box: a huge robot made of scrap, a curved satellite housing on its back like Rook's shell, spare parts sticking out of every joint, one mustard lamp eye.

gravity_well.brief: Ring machine pulling bolts into its middle. Accent: teal.
gravity_well.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: the Magnet Crane's long arm lying flat with a ring machine at its far end, small bolts spiralling into the ring's dark middle like into a tiny black hole, teal rings.

sun_shard.brief: Shard of a dying star wrapped in moth silk. Accent: mustard.
sun_shard.description: A broken shard of a dying star, flat mustard and coral red with black cracks, one end wrapped in pale moth silk as a grip, wavy heat lines rising.

prayer_bell.brief: Bronze bell like the one Ysel holds. Accent: mustard.
prayer_bell.description: A small bronze bell like the one Ysel holds in her lower hand, a star-shard bead as its clapper, hanging from a cord of moth silk.

eclipse_veil.brief: Folded night-blue veil with an eclipse ring. Accent: cream.
eclipse_veil.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long veil of night-blue cloth from Ysel's order stretched out and rippling, a gold band of sun and moon phases along its edge, an eclipse ring stitched in the middle.

sundial.brief: Moth-wing sundial casting a star shadow. Accent: copper.
sundial.description: A small bronze sundial shaped like an open moth wing, its pointer a feathered antenna, its shadow falling on a cracked star mark.

flare_catcher.brief: Wing-shaped hoop catching a flare ribbon. Accent: mustard.
flare_catcher.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long pole lying flat with a bronze hoop strung like a moth wing at one end, catching a curling solar flare drawn as a flat mustard ribbon that trails to the other end.

ember_censer.brief: Hanging censer shaped like a cocoon. Accent: coral red.
ember_censer.description: Upright: a hanging bronze censer shaped like a moth cocoon on chains, embers inside, wavy heat lines rising from its lid.

corona_staff.brief: Staff crowned by eclipse rings around a sun piece. Accent: mustard.
corona_staff.description: Upright through the tall box: a staff of Ysel's order, dark shaft with a coral red band, crowned by nested eclipse rings, a cracked sun piece floating inside, flat mustard with black cracks.

comet_rosary.brief: String of star-shard beads, one a comet. Accent: cream.
comet_rosary.description: Running the full length of the long box, end to end: a long string of star-shard beads pulled straight, one bead shaped like a comet with a short tail at one end, a small bronze bell at the other.

dawn_chime.brief: Chime of bronze tubes with sun rays. Accent: mustard.
dawn_chime.description: A bronze chime of hanging tubes under a small moth-wing roof, each tube cut with small sun rays.

red_giant_heart.brief: Swollen red star held by eclipse rings. Accent: coral red.
red_giant_heart.description: Filling the square box: a swollen coral red star held in nested bronze eclipse rings like a reliquary, its cracks widening, a singed moth wing scale stuck to one ring, heat as wavy lines.

collapse_engine.brief: Machine with a star collapsing into its core. Accent: coral red.
collapse_engine.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long bronze machine of the order lying flat with moth-wing vents along both sides, a cracked star collapsing into a round core in its middle, pieces falling inward in a spiral.

sunblade.brief: Short sword with the Sun Shard in its hilt. Accent: mustard.
sunblade.description: Upright: a short sword of the order, the Sun Shard set in the hilt with moth silk, the Crystal Shard ground into its edge.

chime_of_hours.brief: Prayer Bell crowned by the wing sundial. Accent: mustard.
chime_of_hours.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long bronze beam lying flat with three bronze prayer bells hanging under it in a row, the moth-wing Sundial fixed on top of the beam.

helios_rod.brief: Corona Staff with the censer hanging from it. Accent: mustard.
helios_rod.description: Upright through the tall box: the Corona Staff grown longer, the cocoon Ember Censer hanging from its ring crown, a small sun burning inside.

umbral_mantle.brief: Night-blue robe with a shadow too long. Accent: cream.
umbral_mantle.description: Filling the square box: the heavy night-blue robe of Ysel's order with gold bands of sun and moon phases, laid flat, its shadow longer than it should be, a faint bubble ring round it.

dying_star_scepter.brief: Sceptre with the Red Giant Heart in its rings. Accent: coral red.
dying_star_scepter.description: Upside-down L: a big ring cage holding the Red Giant Heart fills the upper four cells edge to edge; under its left half only, a thick shaft runs down the lower left cell to the bottom, a small cocoon censer tied to it; nothing in the lower right.

solstice_engine.brief: Engine with two half-suns, chime and flare ring. Accent: mustard.
solstice_engine.description: Filling the square box: a bronze engine with two half-suns on its sides, the Dawn Chime hanging from it, the wing hoop of the Flare Catcher on top.

nova_crown.brief: Long diadem of rings round a star gone cold. Accent: teal.
nova_crown.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long bronze diadem of bent eclipse rings stretched wide, a dark star gone cold set in the middle, frost cracks on its surface, pieces held still in the rings.

eternal_dawn.brief: Small sun rising out of a ring, never up. Accent: mustard.
eternal_dawn.description: A small sun rising out of a bronze eclipse ring, never quite up, half hidden behind the ring, two feathered antennae framing it.

stellar_lens.brief: Lens in a wing-shaped frame with a star inside. Accent: teal.
stellar_lens.description: A large lens in a bronze frame shaped like spread moth wings, a tiny star caught sharp in the middle of the glass.

votive_candle.brief: Candle in a stone cup with a moth on its rim. Accent: mustard.
votive_candle.description: A candle in a small moon-rock cup, a star pressed into the wax, a flat mustard flame, a tiny pale moth resting on the rim.

hymn_scroll.brief: Open scroll with star-phase symbols. Accent: cream.
hymn_scroll.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long prayer scroll of the solar moths unrolled flat, its rolled ends at both sides, covered in small star-phase symbols instead of letters, a singed edge.

solar_dagger.brief: Small dagger with a sun etched on the blade. Accent: mustard.
solar_dagger.description: A small dark dagger with a mustard sun etched on the blade, its guard shaped like two folded moth wings.

mirror_of_dusk.brief: Hand mirror showing a setting red sun. Accent: coral red.
mirror_of_dusk.description: Standing tall from the bottom to the top of the box: a tall bronze hand mirror with a long handle reaching the bottom, a tall oval moth-wing frame, the glass showing a setting coral red sun over a dark horizon.

star_psalter.brief: Thick hymn book with a star clasp. Accent: mustard.
star_psalter.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a thick hymn book of the order lying open flat, both covers spread wide, bound in night-blue cloth with a gold band, a bronze star clasp, a moth-wing bookmark.

pyre_lantern.brief: Lantern with a fire and a moth circling it. Accent: coral red.
pyre_lantern.description: A bronze lantern with a small fire inside, wavy heat lines rising, one tiny pale moth circling it.

eclipse_orb.brief: Long stone capsule with a dark disc crossing a sun. Accent: cream.
eclipse_orb.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long moon-stone capsule held in a long bronze stand of spread wings, a black disc crossing a sun on its face.

white_dwarf.brief: Tiny dense star bending its heavy ring. Accent: cream.
white_dwarf.description: Filling the square box: a small very dense cream star held in a heavy bronze ring, the ring bending under its weight, singed moth scales stuck to it.

supernova_seed.brief: Cocoon-shaped cage with a star about to burst. Accent: coral red.
supernova_seed.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long cocoon-shaped bronze cage lying on its side with a star about to burst inside, its cracks coral red, pointed ends at both sides.

twin_suns.brief: Sun Shard and Solar Dagger crossed. Accent: mustard.
twin_suns.description: Standing tall from the bottom to the top of the box: the silk-wrapped Sun Shard and the Solar Dagger held upright side by side, tied together at the grips at the bottom, blades reaching the top, both with sun marks in mustard.

sacred_flame.brief: Flame in a stone bowl inside a lantern frame. Accent: coral red.
sacred_flame.description: A flame in a moon-rock bowl like the Votive Candle's cup, the Pyre Lantern's bronze frame around it, wavy heat lines.

litany.brief: Long prayer scroll unrolled with a bell at each end. Accent: cream.
litany.description: Running the full length of the long box, end to end: a long prayer scroll unrolled flat, a small bronze bell tied at each end, the comet bead string draped along its whole length.

total_eclipse.brief: Round moth-wing shield painted with a total eclipse. Accent: cream.
total_eclipse.description: Filling the square box edge to edge: a round shield painted with a total eclipse, two moth wings spread across it, crescent moons at the rim, the Mirror of Dusk set in its centre.

event_horizon.brief: Black ring shield with stars bending round it. Accent: teal.
event_horizon.description: Filling the tall box: a black ring shield with stars bending round its edge, the White Dwarf at its centre, the night-blue Umbral Mantle hanging behind it.

canticle.brief: Book of last light with a flare rising. Accent: mustard.
canticle.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: the Star Psalter lying open flat as a book of last light, both covers spread wide, a flare curling along its pages as a flat mustard ribbon, singed moth scales on the pages.

space_hamster.brief: Round hamster with ore-stuffed cheeks and breathing gills. Accent: mustard.
space_hamster.description: A round hamster from a thin-air desert planet, cheeks stuffed with shiny ore pebbles, frilly breathing gills on its neck, small room around it. Mustard fur.

moon_moth.brief: Pale moth with two crescent moons on each wing. Accent: cream.
moon_moth.description: A pale moth from a planet with two moons, each wing marked with two dark crescents, feathery antennae, fuzzy body, wings spread wide.

vacuum_slug.brief: Hull slug with a suction mouth and a helmet-like shell. Accent: sage.
vacuum_slug.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long fat hull slug, a round suction mouth at one end, its tail at the other, a little dome shell like a pressure helmet on its back, a sage slime trail.

rock_crab.brief: Flat crab pressed low by gravity, eyes on long periscope stalks. Accent: copper.
rock_crab.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a wide squat crab pressed flat by the heavy gravity of Ochre, legs spread wide to both sides, shell of layered red sandstone, two eyes on long periscope stalks, one thick crystal claw. One single animal.

glow_beetle.brief: Beetle with a lamp rear and a ringed-planet shell. Accent: mustard.
glow_beetle.description: A beetle seen from above, its rear end a round lamp drawn as a flat mustard shape, its shell patterned like a tiny planet with one ring.

asteroid_mole.brief: Mole with diamond claws and a tiny tail jet for drifting. Accent: copper.
asteroid_mole.description: Standing tall from the bottom to the top of the box: a stubby mole standing up tall on its hind legs, huge diamond-tipped digging claws raised high, an asteroid crumb on its nose, its tail ending in a tiny jet at the bottom.

dust_bunny.brief: Fluffy tumbleweed bunny with a dust devil spinning under it. Accent: cream.
dust_bunny.description: A round ball of grey fluff from a windy desert planet, rolling like a tumbleweed, two long ears, two dot eyes, a tiny dust devil spinning under it.

scout_drone.brief: Flat wide drone with one big camera eye and two rotors. Accent: teal.
scout_drone.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a flat wide drone hovering level, one big teal camera eye in the middle of its round body, a rotor at each end, nothing hanging below.

comet_fox.brief: Long-legged comet fox mid-leap with a dust-trail tail. Accent: cream.
comet_fox.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a lean comet fox mid-leap in side view, nose at one end, its long tail of frozen dust streaming to the other, long thin legs, big ears like tiny antenna dishes. One single animal.

repair_bot.brief: Small wrench-armed robot carrying a roll of hull tape. Accent: mustard.
repair_bot.description: Standing tall from the bottom to the top of the box: a small robot standing tall on two long legs, one arm a wrench, one round mustard eye at the top, a tall roll of hull tape worn like a backpack.

laser_parrot.brief: Round parrot from Gemell with a lens beak and a dish crest. Accent: coral red.
laser_parrot.description: A plump parrot from Gemell's twilight forests standing upright, wings folded, its beak a coral red lens in a copper ring, its crest a small fanned dish, big dusk eyes.

nebula_jelly.brief: Jellyfish with a nebula cloud inside its bell. Accent: teal.
nebula_jelly.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a jellyfish drifting sideways, its bell a see-through dome at one end with a small teal swirl of nebula cloud inside, long tentacles trailing out to the other end like dust trails.

sentry_drone.brief: Hovering drone with a gun built into its belly. Accent: coral red.
sentry_drone.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a hovering drone in side view, a rotor pod on top at each end, one lens eye at the front, a short coral red gun barrel built into its belly pointing forward, nothing hanging below.

magma_newt.brief: Basalt-skinned newt with heat cracks and a glass tail. Accent: coral red.
magma_newt.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a lava-planet newt in side view, head at one end, its tail ending in a lump of volcanic glass at the other, skin cracked like cooling black basalt with coral red heat in the cracks.

ice_ferret.brief: Slinky Rime ferret with an ice-crystal crest along its spine. Accent: teal.
ice_ferret.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long slinky ferret from Rime stretched out flat, head at one end and tail at the other, white fur, a crest of clear teal ice crystals along its spine, big pale eyes.

tardigrade.brief: Chubby tardigrade in a tiny space helmet, unbothered. Accent: cream.
tardigrade.description: A chubby wrinkled cream tardigrade with eight stubby clawed legs, wearing a tiny round space helmet it does not need, looking completely unbothered.

shadow_lynx.brief: Shadow cat stalking low, eclipse ring round its outline. Accent: mustard.
shadow_lynx.description: Stretched end to end across the long box: a lynx of pure black shadow stalking low in side view, nose at one end, long tail at the other, rimmed by a thin mustard ring like a solar eclipse, ear tufts, cream eyes.

star_whale_calf.brief: Chubby baby whale with star freckles swimming through space. Accent: teal.
star_whale_calf.description: Filling the wide box: a chubby baby whale swimming sideways through space, its back speckled with small stars like freckles, a big curious eye and a short spout of mist. Underbelly in pale bone with grooves, the back teal.

void_kraken.brief: Dark tentacled beast with one huge teal eye. Accent: teal.
void_kraken.description: A dark tentacled beast filling the box: head and body across the top two rows edge to edge, two thick tentacles hanging straight down into the bottom left and bottom right cells only, the bottom middle cell stays plain. One huge round teal eye is the focus; suckers as cream dots, skin night-blue under heavy black shadow.

guardian_drone.brief: Drone holding a round shield plate in front of it. Accent: teal.
guardian_drone.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a drone hovering behind a long oval shield plate held across its front by two arms, the shield reaching both ends, teal on the shield.

purifier_bot.brief: Small robot with a big filter mask for a face. Accent: sage.
purifier_bot.description: Standing tall from the bottom to the top of the box: a small robot standing tall, a big sage air filter mask for a face at the top, a little round body, two thin arms and two long legs reaching the bottom.

laser_pistol.brief: Chunky pistol whose barrel is a stack of lens rings, solar fin on the back. Accent: coral red.
laser_pistol.description: Upright, barrel pointing up: a chunky pistol whose barrel is a short stack of three teal lens rings, a small solar fin on its back to recharge it, the grip wrapped in tape.

rivet_gun.brief: Hull-repair gun from a thruster nozzle, rivets riding round it like a planet ring. Accent: copper.
rivet_gun.description: A stubby hull-repair gun built from a cut-down thruster nozzle. Fat rivets ride round the barrel on a wire ring like a planet ring; the muzzle is a rubber suction clamp for hull plates. Copper hose fittings.

plasma_cutter.brief: Wreck-salvage cutter with a short plasma blade and a magnet clamp. Accent: coral red.
plasma_cutter.description: Lying across the box: a wreck-salvage cutter built from a welding torch and a ship's fuel valve, a short flat coral red blade of plasma at the nozzle, a magnet clamp on the housing so it sticks to hulls in zero gravity.

asteroid_chunk.brief: A throwable little asteroid with a carry strap and a pebble moon beside it. Accent: copper.
asteroid_chunk.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long lumpy grey-brown asteroid shaped like a potato, a carry strap bolted along it so it can be thrown, a tiny pebble moon floating at one end.

stun_baton.brief: Baton from a broken antenna mast, spark between two prongs. Accent: mustard.
stun_baton.description: Upright, prongs at the top: a baton made from a broken antenna mast, two bent prongs with a flat mustard zig-zag spark between them, a short coiled tether cord with a clip at the grip end.

mining_pick.brief: L-shaped meteor-iron pick with a crystal tip and a small thruster. Accent: teal.
mining_pick.description: The pick head runs along the top two cells, the handle drops down the left cell; the empty corner stays free. Meteor-iron head with a teal crystal tip and a small thruster on its back, taped grip, tether clip.

fang_dagger.brief: A crystal-tipped fang lashed to a short hilt. Accent: cream.
fang_dagger.description: A single curved cream fang of a crystal-toothed beast from Facet, its tip a teal crystal, lashed to a short wrapped hilt with a tether clip at the end.

flare_gun.brief: Fat flare pistol, the cartridge in its breech is a tiny finned rocket. Accent: coral red.
flare_gun.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long-barrelled flare pistol lying flat, grip at one end and a long barrel to the other, its breech hinged open showing a tiny coral red finned rocket cartridge inside.

boomerang_blade.brief: V-shaped blade cut from a ship's wing tip, steering thrusters on both ends. Accent: copper.
boomerang_blade.description: Lying across the box: a V-shaped blade cut from a spaceship's wing tip, a tiny steering thruster on each end so it curves back in zero gravity, a wrapped grip in the bend. Copper edges.

plasma_sword.brief: Plasma blade on a docking-clamp hilt with vent-fin guard. Accent: coral red.
plasma_sword.description: Standing tall from the bottom to the top of the tall box: a hilt made from a docking clamp at the bottom, a crossguard of vent fins, above it a long flat coral red plasma blade with a black core line reaching the very top.

harpoon_launcher.brief: Wreck-catching harpoon launcher with a magnet grab and towline. Accent: copper.
harpoon_launcher.description: Lying along the long box: a shoulder launcher made from a cargo crane arm, a barbed harpoon head with a round magnet grab in front, a coiled towline hanging under the barrel. Built for catching drifting wrecks.

cryo_sprayer.brief: Spray gun with a tank of Rime methane ice, hexagon frost spray. Accent: teal.
cryo_sprayer.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long spray gun lying flat, a long tank of frozen methane from the night planet Rime along its top, the frost-crusted nozzle at one end, a few flat teal hexagon ice crystals stuck to the nozzle.

ion_blaster.brief: Blaster whose barrel is three floating rings like planet rings. Accent: teal.
ion_blaster.description: Upright, muzzle up: a blaster whose barrel is three teal rings floating apart with nothing between them, like stacked planet rings, below a bulky grip with a small battery dial.

spore_launcher.brief: Fat living tube gun grown from a Murk puffball. Accent: sage.
spore_launcher.description: Filling the wide box edge to edge, top to bottom: a fat tube gun grown from a giant Murk puffball fungus, a hinged mushroom-cap breech at one end, a wide open muzzle at the other, a row of big sage spore pods along its side.

meteor_hammer.brief: Hammer whose head is a whole little meteor with a re-entry scorch. Accent: coral red.
meteor_hammer.description: Filling the square box diagonally: a short iron haft with a lumpy dark meteor fused on as the head, its front scorched from re-entry with flat coral red crack shapes, no glow. Leather wrap on the grip.

tentacle_whip.brief: Whip of a nebula squid tentacle, tip curled like a galaxy. Accent: cream.
tentacle_whip.description: Along the long box: a wrapped hilt at one end, from it a long tapering tentacle of a squid from the Veil nebula in loose curves, a row of cream suckers, its tip curled into a spiral like a small galaxy.

shock_gauntlet.brief: Space-suit glove with plated knuckles and a coil battery. Accent: mustard.
shock_gauntlet.description: Upright: one armoured space-suit glove clenched into a fist, heavy plated knuckles, a small coil battery on the wrist, two flat mustard sparks jumping between the knuckles.

needle_rifle.brief: Long thin rifle with a drum of crystal needles from Facet. Accent: teal.
needle_rifle.description: Along the long box: a thin long-barrelled rifle with a slim stock and a long scope, under the middle a see-through drum full of teal crystal needles from the planet Facet.

acid_flask.brief: Flask with a pressure valve, acid floating as a ball inside. Accent: sage.
acid_flask.description: A round flask with a pressure valve instead of a stopper, sage acid inside floating as a ball in zero gravity, one drop eating a hole in the glass.

ripper_saw.brief: Hand saw whose tooth chain circles the bar like a planet ring. Accent: coral red.
ripper_saw.description: Lying across the box: a short hand saw whose chain of black triangle teeth circles a flat bar like a planet's ring, a chunky coral red motor grip at the back with a tether clip.

railgun.brief: Two rails from a station docking track on a boxy grip. Accent: teal.
railgun.description: Running the full length of the long box, end to end: two very long straight parallel teal rails taken from a station's docking track, braces between them, a boxy grip and a fat capacitor at one end.

gamma_lance.brief: Pole lance tipped with a caged reactor rod. Accent: mustard.
gamma_lance.description: Along the long box: a long pole lance, its tip a heavy reactor rod in a small cage marked with three flat mustard radiation wedges, a cable spiralling down the shaft to a battery at the butt.

swarm_missiles.brief: Honeycomb rack of small rockets with a tether clip. Accent: coral red.
swarm_missiles.description: A square honeycomb rack seen from the front, every cell holding a small coral red rocket nose, two cells empty and scorched, a short tether clip on the top edge. The whole rack fits inside the frame.

antimatter_dagger.brief: Dagger with a blade of black void, debris falling into it. Accent: cream.
antimatter_dagger.description: A small dagger whose blade is a flat black void with a crisp cream outline, two tiny specks of debris falling into it, an iron hilt with a containment ring.

photon_bow.brief: Bow bent from a solar panel strip, arrow with a star head. Accent: mustard.
photon_bow.description: Upright through the tall box: a bow bent from a long strip of solar panel with flat teal cells, the string a straight mustard line, a small five-pointed star at the top tip.

void_scythe.brief: L-shaped scythe whose blade is a slice of night sky. Accent: cream.
void_scythe.description: The curved blade sweeps across the top row, the long shaft runs down the left cells; the right lower cells stay empty. The blade is a slice of night sky, black with a few tiny cream stars and a thin crescent moon; the shaft plain iron with a tether ring.

solar_cannon.brief: Heavy cannon with a sun-shaped fan of heat plates round the muzzle. Accent: mustard.
solar_cannon.description: A heavy, squat cannon lying across the box, muzzle to one side. Around the muzzle a fan of bent metal plates like a sun-shaped heat shield; scorched plating on the barrel and two fat cables running back into a boxy breech. Mustard only on the plates of the fan.

graviton_maul.brief: Maul with a round head circled by two orbit rings carrying debris. Accent: teal.
graviton_maul.description: The heavy head fills the upper four cells, the haft drops down the lower left cell; the lower right stays empty. Around the round head two thin teal orbit rings tilt at an angle; small debris pieces hang in the rings.

ram_plate.brief: Hull plate with a short ram spike. Accent: teal.
ram_plate.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long dented hull plate lying flat with a riveted ram spike reaching out to one end, a flat teal ring of force around the spike tip.

drone_bay.brief: Scrap hatch with one drone lifting off. Accent: copper.
drone_bay.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long open hangar hatch built from scrap lying flat, one tiny welded drone with copper rotors lifting off at one end, a second one peeking out at the other.

marrow_treat.brief: Cracked bone with marrow, tied with fur cord. Accent: cream.
marrow_treat.description: A thick cracked bone of some huge space beast, soft marrow inside, tied with a fur cord, a few crumbs floating round it.

trellis.brief: Lattice of lab rods with climbing tendrils. Accent: sage.
trellis.description: A small lattice of bent lab rods stuck in a magnetic pot, thin sage tendrils climbing up it and reaching sideways.

frost_bell.brief: Bronze bell rimmed with frost. Accent: teal.
frost_bell.description: A small dark bronze bell rimmed with frost, its clapper a teal ice bead, a ring of cold drawn as ink lines below it.

breach_ram.brief: Short hydraulic ram on a welded arm. Accent: teal.
breach_ram.description: Standing tall from the bottom to the top of the box: a tall hydraulic ram standing upright on a welded arm, the base at the bottom, the blunt riveted head at the top scuffed bare, teal force lines drawn as ink arcs round the head.

siege_ram.brief: Long piston ram with a wedge head. Accent: teal.
siege_ram.description: Running the full length of the long box, end to end: a very long piston ram, a heavy wedge head at one end, the piston housing at the other, salvaged shield plates bolted along both flanks, teal force lines at the tip.

glutton_toad.brief: Fat three-eyed toad with stuffed cheeks. Accent: sage.
glutton_toad.description: Standing tall from the bottom to the top of the box: a fat sage toad standing up tall on its hind legs, belly round and stretched, wide grin, three eyes on long stalks at the top, crater-like spots, cheeks bulging with food.

trough_boar.brief: Stocky boar with its snout in a root. Accent: mustard.
trough_boar.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long stocky boar from a dust moon in side view, snout at one end and tail at the other, bristled mustard back, crystal tusks, long thin legs, snout down in a half-eaten root.

dawn_needle.brief: Thin throwing needle with a sun-ray tip. Accent: copper.
dawn_needle.description: Upright: a thin dark throwing needle of the order, its tip forged as a small mustard sun ray, the grip wound in moth silk with a coral red band.

zenith_lance.brief: Slim lance with a sun disc below the point. Accent: mustard.
zenith_lance.description: Upright through the tall box: a slim dark lance of the order, a small mustard sun disc below a long point, a coral red band and a string of star-shard beads on the shaft.

pebble_mites.brief: One tiny mite whose shell is a round ore pebble. Accent: mustard.
pebble_mites.description: One single tiny mite whose shell is a round grey pebble with a mustard ore speck, six thin legs and two long feelers, room around it.

needle_wasps.brief: One needle wasp with a syringe stinger and solar-sail wings. Accent: mustard.
needle_wasps.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: one single needle wasp in side view, lean striped body stretched long, a long hollow stinger like a syringe needle reaching one end, stiff ribbed solar-sail wings along its back, a cluster of small eyes.

thorn_hedge.brief: Low thorn hedge in a cracked planter. Accent: sage.
thorn_hedge.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a long low hedge of thorny branches growing out of a long cracked magnetic lab planter, black hooked thorns, a torn strip of suit fabric caught in them.

rot_bloom.brief: Wilted dark flower slumped out of a jar. Accent: coral red.
rot_bloom.description: Stretched end to end across the wide box: a wilted dark flower slumped out of a cracked specimen jar lying on its side, the long drooping stem reaching to the other end, petals with no face, thick coral red sap floating off as balls.

dune_ox.brief: Shaggy ox with dish-shaped horns and a mossy saddle back. Accent: copper.
dune_ox.description: Filling the square box: one big shaggy ox of the Herdworld plains in side view, all four legs clearly visible, head lowered, its two horns shaped like small satellite dishes, its broad back a flat saddle of moss. One front hoof scraping the ground.

tundra_yak.brief: Ice-spiked yak with snowshoe hooves and big pale eyes. Accent: teal.
tundra_yak.description: Filling the square box: a huge yak from a frozen night planet. Its shaggy coat is stiff with blue ice spikes, its hooves are wide and flat like snowshoes for walking on frozen methane seas, and big pale eyes for the long darkness. Short heavy horns, a dented copper bell on a rope.
